<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Billing;

use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceBook;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;

/**
 * Pure billing rules (no I/O):
 *  - resolve the price row in force at the event timestamp;
 *  - compute the exact (unrounded) cost;
 *  - apply the provider off-peak multiplier when the event's UTC
 *    time-of-day falls inside the window (multiplier is applied to the full
 *    event cost, not per kind);
 *  - round to 6 digits (HALF_UP, 2.5 → 3) once per event.
 *
 * No floating point anywhere.
 */
final class BillingEngine
{
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1000000; // "per_1m_tokens" ⇒ ÷ 1 000 000

    public function __construct(
        private readonly PriceBook $book,
    ) {
    }

    /**
     * @return RatingResult rating + the exact & rounded cost, or "unrated"
     */
    public function rateEvent(
        string $providerCode,
        string $modelCode,
        \DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc,
        TokenUsage $tokens,
    ): RatingResult {
        $row = $this->book->rateInForce($providerCode, $modelCode, $tsUtc);
        if ($row === null) {
            return RatingResult::unrated();
        }

        $exact = $this->exactCost($row, $tokens);

        $offPeak = $this->book->providerOffPeak($providerCode);
        if ($offPeak !== null && $offPeak->contains($this->utcMinutesOfDay($tsUtc))) {
            $exact = $exact->multiply(\App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($offPeak->multiplier));
        }

        $rounded = $exact->roundTo(\App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);

        return RatingResult::rated(
            provider: $providerCode,
            modelCode: $modelCode,
            row: $row,
            offPeak: $offPeak,
            exact: $exact,
            cost: $rounded,
            offPeakApplied: $offPeak !== null && $offPeak->contains($this->utcMinutesOfDay($tsUtc)),
        );
    }

    private function exactCost(PriceRow $row, TokenUsage $t): \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($row->isUnified()) {
            return \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $t->total())
                ->multiply(\App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($row->rate('any')))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }

        return \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add($this->term($t->input, $row->rate('input')))
            ->add($this->term($t->output, $row->rate('output')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheRead, $row->rate('cache_read')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheWrite, $row->rate('cache_write')));
    }

    private function term(int $tokens, string $rate): \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) {
            return \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::zero();
        }

        return \App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $tokens)
            ->multiply(\App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }

    private function utcMinutesOfDay(\DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc): int
    {

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Billing;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceBook;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;

/**
 * Pure billing rules (no I/O):
 *  - resolve the price row in force at the event timestamp (most recent validFrom ≤ ts);
 *  - no row ⇒ the event is unrated, not an error;
 *  - compute the exact (unrounded) cost from the row's decimal rates
 *    (tokens × rate ÷ 1 000 000 per "per_1m_tokens" unit);
 *  - apply the provider off-peak multiplier to the total event cost when the
 *    event's UTC time-of-day falls in the window;
 *  - single, final rounding to 6 digits (HALF_UP, 2.5 → 3).
 *
 * No floating point anywhere in this path.
 */
final class BillingEngine
{
    /** "per_1m_tokens" ⇒ rate is per 1 000 000 tokens. */
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1000000;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly PriceBook $book,
    ) {
    }

    public function rateEvent(
        string $providerCode,
        string $modelCode,
        \DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc,
        TokenUsage $tokens,
    ): RatingResult {
        $row = $this->book->rateInForce($providerCode, $modelCode, $tsUtc);
        if ($row === null) {
            return RatingResult::unrated($providerCode, $modelCode);
        }

        $exact = $this->exactCost($row, $tokens);

        $offPeak = $this->book->providerOffPeak($providerCode);
        $offPeakApplied = false;
        if ($offPeak !== null && $offPeak->contains($this->utcMinutesOfDay($tsUtc))) {
            $exact = $exact->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($offPeak->multiplier));
            $offPeakApplied = true;
        }

        $cost = $exact->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);

        return new RatingResult(
            rating: RatingStatus::RATED,
            providerCode: $providerCode,
            modelCode: $modelCode,
            priceRow: $row,
            offPeak: $offPeakApplied ? $offPeak : null,
            offPeakApplied: $offPeakApplied,
            exactCost: $exact,
            cost: $cost,
        );
    }

    private function exactCost(PriceRow $row, TokenUsage $t): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($row->isUnified()) {
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $t->total())
                ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($row->rate('any')))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }

        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add($this->term($t->input, $row->rate('input')))
            ->add($this->term($t->output, $row->rate('output')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheRead, $row->rate('cache_read')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheWrite, $row->rate('cache_write')));
    }

    private function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) {
            return DecimalMoney::zero();
        }

        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }

    private function utcMinutesOfDay(\DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc): int
    {
        return (int) $tsUtc->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'))->format('Hi');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ModelEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ProviderEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

final class ApplicationServices
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
    ) {
    }

    // ===================== Prices import =====================

    /**
     * Import prices JSON.
     * @param array $providers list of provider dicts
     * @param array $models    list of model dicts
     * @return ImportResult
     */
    public function importPrices(array $providers, array $models): ImportResult
    {
        $errors = [];
        $success = [];
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        // --- Providers ---
        foreach ($providers as $idx => $p) {
            $label = sprintf('providers[%d]', $idx);
            [$code, $name, $offPeak, $e] = self::parseProvider($p, $label);
            if ($e !== null) {
                $errors[] = $e;
                continue;
            }
            $entity = $this->em->find(ProviderEntity::class, $code) ?? new ProviderEntity();
            $entity->code       = $code;
            $entity->name       = $name;
            $entity->offPeakStartMin     = $offPeak?->startMinutes;
            $entity->offPeakEndMin       = $offPeak?->endMinutes;
            $entity->offPeakMultiplier   = $offPeak?->multiplier;
            $entity->createdAt = $this->em->find(ProviderEntity::class, $code)?->createdAt ?? $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $success[] = $label;
        }

        // --- Models ---
        $providerCodes = array_map(fn($p) => $p['code'] ?? null, $providers);
        foreach ($models as $idx => $m) {
            $label = sprintf('models[%d]', $idx);
            [$providerCode, $code, $modelName, $e] = self::parseModelRow($m, $label);
            if ($e !== null) {
                $errors[] = $e;
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($providerCode, $providerCodes, true)) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider \"$providerCode\" not declared in this prices file";
                continue;
            }
            // unique model key
            $existing = $this->em->createQueryBuilder()
                ->select('m')->from(ModelEntity::class, 'm')
                ->where('m.providerCode = :pc AND m.code = :c')
                ->setParameter('pc', $providerCode)
                ->setParameter('c', $code)
                ->getQuery()->getOneOrNullResult();
            $entity = $existing ?? new ModelEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $providerCode;
            $entity->code         = $code;
            $entity->modelName    = $modelName;
            $entity->createdAt    = $existing?->createdAt ?? $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $success[] = $label;
        }

        $this->em->flush();

        return new ImportResult(
            successCount: count($success),
            skippedCount: count($errors),
            errors: $errors,
        );
    }

    private static function parseProvider(array $p, string $label): array
    {
        $e = null;
        $code = $p['code'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') {
            $e = "$label: \"code\" is required (non-empty string)";
            return [$code, '', null, $e];
        }
        $name = $p['name'] ?? $code;
        if (!is_string($name) || $name === '') {
            $e = "$label: \"name\" must be a non-empty string";
            return [$code, $name, null, $e];
        }
        $offPeak = null;
        if (isset($p['off_peak'])) {
            $op = $p['off_peak'];
            if (!is_array($op)) {
                $e = "$label: \"off_peak\" must be an object";
                return [$code, $name, null, $e];
            }
            $start = $op['utc_start'] ?? null;
            $end   = $op['utc_end']   ?? null;
            $multi = $op['multiplier'] ?? null;
            if (!is_string($start) || !preg_match('/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/', $start)) {
                $e = "$label: off_peak.utc_start must be \"HH:MM\"";
                return [$code, $name, null, $e];
            }
            if (!is_string($end) || !preg_match('/^\d{2}:\d{2}$/', $end)) {
                $e = "$label: off_peak.utc_end must be \"HH:MM\"";
                return [$code, $name, null, $e];
            }
            if (!is_string($multi) || !preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d{1,6})?$/', $multi)) {
                $e = "$label: off_peak.multiplier must be a decimal string (≤6 fractional digits)";
                return [$code, $name, null, $e];
            }
            try {
                $offPeak = OffPeakWindow::fromHhmm($start, $end, $multi);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $ex) {
                $e = "$label: off_peak: " . $ex->getMessage();
                return [$code, $name, null, $e];
            }
        }

        return [$code, $name, $offPeak, null];
    }

    private static function parseModelRow(array $m, string $label): array
    {
        $providerCode = $m['provider'] ?? null;
        $code         = $m['code']     ?? null;
        $modelName    = $m['model_name'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($providerCode) || $providerCode === '') {
            return ['', '', $modelName, "$label: \"provider\" is required"];
        }
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') {
            return [$providerCode, '', $modelName, "$label: \"code\" is required"];
        }
        if ($modelName !== null && !is_string($modelName)) {
            return ['', '', $modelName, "$label: \"model_name\" must be a string or null"];
        }

        return [$providerCode, $code, $modelName, null];
    }

    // ===================== Usage import =====================

    /**
     * Import a usage JSONL file.
     * @return ImportResult
     */
    public function importUsage(string $filePath): ImportResult
    {
        if (!is_file($filePath) || !is_readable($filePath)) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, [sprintf('usage file not found or not readable: %s', $filePath)]);
        }

        $errors = [];
        $success = 0;
        $skipped = 0;
        $seenKeys = []; // providerCode|providerRequestId => true (for dedup)

        $fh = fopen($filePath, 'rb');
        if ($fh === false) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, ['could not open file for reading']);
        }

        $lineNo = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            $lineNo++;
            $line = trim($line);
            if ($line === '') {
                continue; // skip blank lines
            }
            $label = "line $lineNo";

            $parsed = self::parseUsageLine($line, $label);
            if ($parsed === null) {
                $skipped++;
                $errors[] = "$label: failed to parse";
                continue;
            }
            [$providerCode, $requestId, $tsUtc, $modelCode, $tokIn, $tokOut, $tokCR, $tokCW] = $parsed;

            // dedup key
            $key = $providerCode . '|' . $requestId;
            if (isset($seenKeys[$key])) {
                $skipped++;
                $success++; // still counted as "imported" (deduped)
                continue;
            }
            $seenKeys[$key] = true;

            // check provider exists
            $provider = $this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $providerCode]);
            if ($provider === null) {
                $skipped++;
                $errors[] = "$label: provider \"$providerCode\" not found in price book";
                continue;
            }
            // check model exists
            $model = $this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy(['providerCode' => $providerCode, 'code' => $modelCode]);
            if ($model === null) {
                $skipped++;
                $errors[] = "$label: model \"$modelCode\" not found for provider \"$providerCode\"";
                continue;
            }

            // persist
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findOneBy(
                ['providerCode' => $providerCode, 'providerRequestId' => $requestId]
            );
            $entity = $existing ?? new UsageEventEntity();
            $entity->providerCode    = $providerCode;
            $entity->providerRequestId = $requestId;
            $entity->tsUtc           = $tsUtc;
            $entity->modelCode       = $modelCode;
            $entity->sourceRow       = $lineNo;
            $entity->tokensInput     = $tokIn;
            $entity->tokensOutput    = $tokOut;
            $entity->tokensCacheRead = $tokCR;
            $entity->tokensCacheWrite= $tokCW;
            $entity->ratingState     = 'pending';
            $entity->ratingState     = 'unrated'; // not yet rated
            $entity->exactCost       = null;
            $entity->cost            = null;
            $entity->currency        = null;
            $entity->rateSpecUnit    = null;
            $entity->rateSpecJson    = null;
            $entity->offPeakApplied  = false;
            $entity->updatedAt       = $now;
            if ($existing === null) {
                $this->em->persist($entity);
            }
            $success++;
        }
        fclose($fh);

        $this->em->flush();
        return new ImportResult(
            successCount: $success,
            skippedCount: $skipped,
            errors: $errors,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @param string $jsonLine
     * @return array|null [providerCode, requestId, tsUtc, modelCode, tokIn, tokOut, tokCR, tokCW] or null on parse error
     */
    private static function parseUsageLine(string $jsonLine, string $label): ?array
    {
        $arr = json_decode($jsonLine, true);
        if (!is_array($arr)) {
            return null;
        }

        $providerCode = $arr['provider'] ?? null;
        $requestId    = $arr['provider_request_id'] ?? null;
        $tsRaw        = $arr['ts_utc'] ?? $arr['ts'] ?? null;
        $modelCode    = $arr['model_code'] ?? $arr['model'] ?? null;
        $tokensRaw    = $arr['tokens'] ?? null;

        if (!is_string($providerCode) || $providerCode === '')  return null;
        if (!is_string($requestId)    || $requestId === '')     return null;
        if (!is_string($tsRaw)        || $tsRaw === '')         return null;
        if (!is_string($modelCode) || $modelCode === '')      return null;

        // Parse timestamp (RFC3339 or similar)
        try {
            $tsUtc = new \DateTimeImmutable($tsRaw, new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        } catch (\Exception) {
            return null;
        }
        // Normalize to UTC
        $tsUtc = $tsUtc->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        // Token counts
        $tokIn  = 0;
        $tokOut = 0;
        $tokCR  = 0;
        $tokCW  = 0;

        if (is_array($tokensRaw) && $tokensRaw !== []) {
            $tokIn  = self::toIntOrThrow($tokensRaw['input']    ?? $tokensRaw['prompt_tokens']    ?? 0)  ?? 0;
            $tokOut = self::toIntOrThrow($tokensRaw['output']   ?? $tokensRaw['completion_tokens']?? 0) ?? 0;
            $tokCR  = self::toIntOrThrow($tokensRaw['cache_read']   ?? $tokensRaw['cache_read_input_tokens']   ?? 0) ?? 0;
            $tokCW  = self::toIntOrThrow($tokensRaw['cache_write']  ?? $tokensRaw['cache_write_input_tokens']  ?? 0) ?? 0;
        } elseif (isset($arr['input_tokens'])) {
            $tokIn  = self::toIntOrThrow($arr['input_tokens'])  ?? 0;
            $tokOut = self::toIntOrThrow($arr['output_tokens']) ?? 0;
            $tokCR  = self::toIntOrThrow($arr['cache_read_input_tokens']  ?? 0) ?? 0;
            $tokCW  = self::toIntOrThrow($arr['cache_write_input_tokens'] ?? 0) ?? 0;
        } else {
            return null; // no token counts found
        }

        if ($tokIn < 0 || $tokOut < 0 || $tokCR < 0 || $tokCW < 0) {
            return null;
        }

        return [$providerCode, $requestId, $tsUtc, $modelCode, $tokIn, $tokOut, $tokCR, $tokCW];
    }

    private static function toIntOrThrow(mixed $v): ?int
    {
        if (is_int($v)) return $v;
        if (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^\d+$/', $v)) return (int)$v;
        return null;
    }

    // ===================== Reprice =====================

    public function repriceAll(): RepriceResult
    {
        $em   = $this->em;
        $repo = $em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class);
        $all  = $repo->findBy([], ['providerCode' => 'ASC', 'providerRequestId' => 'ASC']);

        $ok         = 0;
        $unrated    = 0;
        $errors     = [];
        $now        = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        foreach ($all as $u) {
            try {
                $result = self::rateEvent($em, $u);
                if ($result === null) {
                    $u->ratingState = 'unrated';
                    $u->exactCost   = null;
                    $u->cost        = null;
                    $u->currency    = null;
                    $u->rateSpecUnit  = null;
                    $u->rateSpecJson  = null;
                    $u->offPeakApplied = false;
                    $unrated++;
                } else {
                    [$exact, $cost, $currency, $unit, $specJson, $offPeakAppl] = $result;
                    $u->ratingState   = 'rated';
                    $u->exactCost     = $exact;
                    $u->cost          = $cost;
                    $u->currency      = $currency;
                    $u->rateSpecUnit  = $unit;
                    $u->rateSpecJson  = $specJson;
                    $u->offPeakApplied = $offPeakAppl;
                    $ok++;
                }
                $u->updatedAt = $now;
            } catch (\Throwable $ex) {
                $u->ratingState = 'error';
                $u->error       = $ex->getMessage();
                $u->updatedAt   = $now;
                $errors[] = sprintf('%s/%s: %s', $u->providerCode, $u->providerRequestId, $ex->getMessage());
            }
        }
        $em->flush();

        return new RepriceResult(
            okCount:      $ok,
            unratedCount: $unrated,
            errorCount:   count($errors),
            errors:       $errors,
        );
    }

    /**
     * @return array|null [exactCost(str), cost(str), currency, unit, specJson, offPeakApplied] or null if unpriced
     */
    private static function rateEvent(EntityManagerInterface $em, UsageEventEntity $u): ?array
    {
        // Find most recent price row for this model valid before tsUtc
        $rowEntity = $em->createQueryBuilder()
            ->select('r')
            ->from(PriceRowEntity::class, 'r')
            ->where('r.providerCode = :pc')
            ->andWhere('r.modelCode  = :mc')
            ->andWhere('r.validFrom <= :ts')
            ->orderBy('r.validFrom', 'DESC')
            ->setMaxResults(1)
            ->setParameter('pc', $u->providerCode)
            ->setParameter('mc', $u->modelCode)
            ->setParameter('ts', $u->tsUtc)
            ->getQuery()
            ->getOneOrNullResult();

        if ($rowEntity === null) {
            return null;
        }

        $rateSpec = json_decode($rowEntity->ratesJson, true);
        $unit     = $rowEntity->unit;
        $specJson = $rowEntity->ratesJson;

        // Compute exact cost
        $tok  = new TokenUsage($u->tokensInput, $u->tokensOutput, $u->tokensCacheRead, $u->tokensCacheWrite);
        $cost = self::computeExactCost($unit, $rateSpec, $tok);

        // Apply off-peak multiplier
        $offPeakApplied = false;
        $provider = $em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $u->providerCode]);
        if ($provider !== null && $provider->offPeakStartMin !== null && $provider->offPeakEndMin !== null) {
            $window = new OffPeakWindow(
                startMinutes:  $provider->offPeakStartMin,
                endMinutes:    $provider->offPeakEndMin,
                multiplier:    $provider->offPeakMultiplier ?? '1',
            );
            $minOfDay = $u->tsUtc->format('Hi');
            if ($window->contains((int)$minOfDay)) {
                $cost = $cost->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($provider->offPeakMultiplier ?? '1'));
                $offPeakApplied = true;
            }
        }

        $costRounded = $cost->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);

        return [
            $cost->toBcString(),
            $costRounded->toBcString(),
            $rowEntity->currency ?? 'USD',
            $unit,
            $specJson,
            $offPeakApplied,
        ];
    }

    /**
     * @param array<string,string> $rateSpec
     */
    private static function computeExactCost(string $unit, array $rateSpec, TokenUsage $tok): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            $totalTok = $tok->total();
            if ($totalTok === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
            $rate = DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rateSpec['any']);
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$totalTok)
                ->multiply($rate)
                ->divideByInteger(BillingEngineTokens::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }

        // per_1m_tokens
        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add(self::term($tok->input,     $rateSpec['input']     ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($tok->output,    $rateSpec['output']    ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($tok->cacheRead, $rateSpec['cache_read']?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($tok->cacheWrite,$rateSpec['cache_write']?? '0'));
    }

    private static function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(BillingEngineTokens::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ModelEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ProviderEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity;
use Doctrine\Common\Util\Inflector;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

use function App\Domain\Billing\TOKENS_PER_UNIT;

final class ApplicationServices
{
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1_000_000;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
    ) {}

    // ---------- pricing import ----------

    /**
     * Import providers + models from a decoded prices JSON payload.
     */
    public function importPrices(array $payload): ImportResult
    {
        $errors = [];
        $okProviders = 0;
        $okModels = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        // --- providers ---
        if (!isset($payload['providers']) || !is_array($payload['providers'])) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, ['top-level "providers" key is required and must be an array']);
        }
        foreach ($payload['providers'] as $idx => $p) {
            $label = sprintf('providers[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseProvider($p, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $row['code']]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ProviderEntity();
            $entity->code = $row['code'];
            $entity->name = $row['name'];
            $entity->offPeakStartMin   = $row['offPeak']['startMin'] ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakEndMin     = $row['offPeak']['endMin']   ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakMultiplier = $row['offPeak']['multiplier'] ?? null;
            if ($existing === null) {
                $entity->createdAt = $now;
            }
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okProviders++;
        }

        // --- models ---
        if (!isset($payload['models']) || !is_array($payload['models'])) {
            return new ImportResult($okProviders, 0, 0, array_merge($errors, ['top-level "models" key is required and must be an array']));
        }
        $knownProviderCodes = array_map(fn($p) => is_array($p) ? ($p['code'] ?? null) : null, $payload['providers']);
        foreach ($payload['models'] as $idx => $m) {
            $label = sprintf('models[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseModel($m, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($row['providerCode'], array_filter($knownProviderCodes), true)) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider \"".$row['providerCode']."\" not declared in this prices file";
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode' => $row['providerCode'],
                'code'         => $row['code'],
            ]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ModelEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $row['providerCode'];
            $entity->code         = $row['code'];
            $entity->modelName    = $row['modelName'];
            if ($existing === null) {
                $entity->createdAt = $now;
            }
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okModels++;
        }

        $this->em->flush();

        return new ImportResult($okProviders, $okModels, 0, $errors);
    }

    private static function parseProvider(array $p, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($p)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $code = $p['code'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" is required");
        $name = $p['name'] ?? $code;
        if (!is_string($name) || $name === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"name\" must be a non-empty string");

        $offPeak = null;
        if (isset($p['off_peak'])) {
            $op = $p['off_peak'];
            if (!is_array($op)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"off_peak\" must be an object");
            $start = $op['utc_start'] ?? null;
            $end   = $op['utc_end']   ?? null;
            $multi = $op['multiplier'] ?? null;
            if (!is_string($start) && !is_int($start)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_start required");
            if (!is_string($end)   && !is_int($end))   throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_end required");
            if ($multi === null)   throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.multiplier required");
            $startStr = (string)$start;
            $endStr   = (string)$end;
            if (!preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $startStr)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_start must be HH:MM");
            if (!preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $endStr))   throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_end must be HH:MM");
            try {
                $w = OffPeakWindow::fromHhmm($startStr, $endStr, (string)$multi);
                $offPeak = ['startMin' => $w->startMinutes, 'endMin' => $w->endMinutes, 'multiplier' => (string)$multi];
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak ".$e->getMessage());
            }
        }

        return ['code' => $code, 'name' => $name, 'offPeak' => $offPeak];
    }

    private static function parseModel(array $m, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($m)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $pc  = $m['provider'] ?? null;
        $code= $m['code']     ?? null;
        if (!is_string($pc)   || $pc   === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"provider\" required");
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" required");
        $mn  = $m['model_name'] ?? null;
        if ($mn !== null && !is_string($mn)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"model_name\" must be string");

        return ['providerCode' => $pc, 'code' => $code, 'modelName' => $mn];
    }

    // ---------- usage import ----------

    public function importUsage(string $filePath): ImportResult
    {
        if (!is_file($filePath) || !is_readable($filePath)) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, [sprintf('file not found/readable: %s', $filePath)]);
        }
        $errors = [];
        $ok = 0;
        $seen = [];
        $lineNo = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        $fh = fopen($filePath, 'rb');
        if ($fh === false) return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, ['could not open file']);

        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            $lineNo++;
            $line = trim($line);
            if ($line === '') continue;
            $label = "line $lineNo";

            $obj = json_decode($line, true);
            if (!is_array($obj)) { $errors[] = "$label: invalid JSON"; continue; }

            $pc     = $obj['provider']            ?? null;
            $rid    = $obj['provider_request_id'] ?? null;
            $tsRaw  = $obj['ts_utc']              ?? $obj['ts'] ?? null;
            $mc     = $obj['model_code']          ?? $obj['model'] ?? null;

            if (!is_string($pc) || $pc === '')  { $errors[]="$label: \"provider\" missing"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($rid)|| $rid === '') { $errors[]="$label: \"provider_request_id\" missing"; continue; }
            if ($tsRaw === null)                { $errors[]="$label: \"ts_utc\" missing"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($mc) || $mc === '')  { $errors[]="$label: \"model_code\" missing"; continue; }

            try {
                $tsUtc = (new \DateTimeImmutable((string)$tsRaw))->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
            } catch (\Exception) { $errors[]="$label: invalid timestamp \"$tsRaw\""; continue; }

            // dedup
            $key = $pc."\x00".$rid;
            if (isset($seen[$key])) { $ok++; continue; }
            $seen[$key] = true;

            // check provider + model exist
            if ($this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code'=>$pc]) === null) {
                $errors[]="$label: provider \"$pc\" not in price book"; continue;
            }
            if ($this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy(['providerCode'=>$pc,'code'=>$mc]) === null) {
                $errors[]="$label: model \"$mc\" not found for provider \"$pc\""; continue;
            }

            // tokens
            $tokRaw = $obj['tokens'] ?? $obj['token_usage'] ?? $obj ?? null;
            if (!is_array($tokRaw)) { $errors[]="$label: token counts missing"; continue; }
            $fields = [
                'tokIn'  => ['input','prompt_tokens','input_tokens','prompt'],
                'tokOut' => ['output','completion_tokens','output_tokens','completion'],
                'tokCR'  => ['cache_read','cache_read_input_tokens','cache_read_tokens'],
                'tokCW'  => ['cache_write','cache_write_input_tokens','cache_write_tokens'],
            ];
            $toks = [];
            $ok2 = true;
            foreach ($fields as $name => $cands) {
                $val = null;
                foreach ($cands as $c) {
                    if (isset($tokRaw[$c])) { $val = $tokRaw[$c]; break; }
                }
                $intVal = is_int($val) ? $val : (is_numeric($val) ? (int)$val : 0);
                if ($intVal < 0) { $errors[]="$label: negative token count"; $ok2=false; break; }
                $toks[$name] = $intVal;
            }
            if (!$ok2) continue;
            if (array_sum($toks) === 0) { $errors[]="$label: all zero token counts"; continue; }

            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode'=>$pc, 'providerRequestId'=>$rid
            ]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new UsageEventEntity();
            $entity->providerCode       = $pc;
            $entity->providerRequestId  = $rid;
            $entity->tsUtc              = $tsUtc;
            $entity->modelCode          = $mc;
            $entity->sourceRow          = $lineNo;
            $entity->tokensInput        = $toks['tokIn'];
            $entity->tokensOutput       = $toks['tokOut'];
            $entity->tokensCacheRead    = $toks['tokCR'];
            $entity->tokensCacheWrite   = $toks['tokCW'];
            $entity->ratingState        = 'pending';
            $entity->exactCost          = null;
            $entity->cost               = null;
            $entity->currency           = null;
            $entity->rateSpecUnit       = null;
            $entity->rateSpecJson       = null;
            $entity->offPeakApplied     = false;
            $entity->error              = null;
            $entity->updatedAt          = $now;
            if ($existing === null) $this->em->persist($entity);
            $ok++;
        }
        fclose($fh);
        $this->em->flush();
        return new ImportResult($ok, 0, 0, $errors);
    }

    // ---------- reprice ----------

    public function reprice(): RepriceResult
    {
        $em   = $this->em;
        $all  = $em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findAll();
        $now  = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        $ok=0; $unrated=0; $errors=[];

        foreach ($all as $u) {
            try {
                $res = self::rateEventRow($em, $u);
                if ($res === null) {
                    $u->ratingState='unrated'; $u->exactCost=null; $u->cost=null;
                    $u->currency=null; $u->rateSpecUnit=null; $u->rateSpecJson=null;
                    $u->offPeakApplied=false; $u->error=null;
                    $unrated++;
                } else {
                    [$exact,$cost,$cur,$unit,$specJson,$offAppl] = $res;
                    $u->ratingState='rated'; $u->exactCost=$exact; $u->cost=$cost;
                    $u->currency=$cur; $u->rateSpecUnit=$unit; $u->rateSpecJson=$specJson;
                    $u->offPeakApplied=$offAppl; $u->error=null;
                    $ok++;
                }
                $u->updatedAt=$now;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $u->ratingState='error';
                $u->error=$e->getMessage();
                $u->updatedAt=$now;
                $errors[]=sprintf('%s/%s: %s',$u->providerCode,$u->providerRequestId,$e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        $em->flush();
        return new RepriceResult($ok,$unrated,count($errors),$errors);
    }

    /**
     * @return array|null [exact(str),cost(str),currency,unit,specJson,offPeakApplied(bool)] or null
     */
    private static function rateEventRow(EntityManagerInterface $em, UsageEventEntity $u): ?array
    {
        $rowEntity = $em->createQueryBuilder()
            ->select('r')->from(PriceRowEntity::class,'r')
            ->where('r.providerCode = :pc')
            ->andWhere('r.modelCode = :mc')
            ->andWhere('r.validFrom <= :ts')
            ->orderBy('r.validFrom','DESC')
            ->setMaxResults(1)
            ->setParameter('pc',$u->providerCode)
            ->setParameter('mc',$u->modelCode)
            ->setParameter('ts',$u->tsUtc)
            ->getQuery()->getOneOrNullResult();
        if ($rowEntity === null) return null;

        $rateSpec = json_decode($rowEntity->ratesJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $unit = $rowEntity->unit;
        $tok  = new TokenUsage($u->tokensInput,$u->tokensOutput,$u->tokensCacheRead,$u->tokensCacheWrite);
        $cost = self::exactCost($unit, $rateSpec, $tok);

        $offAppl = false;
        $provider = $em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code'=>$u->providerCode]);
        if ($provider !== null && $provider->offPeakStartMin !== null && $provider->offPeakEndMin !== null && $provider->offPeakMultiplier !== null) {
            $w = new OffPeakWindow($provider->offPeakStartMin, $provider->offPeakEndMin, $provider->offPeakMultiplier);
            $minOfDay = (int)$u->tsUtc->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'))->format('Hi');
            if ($w->contains($minOfDay)) {
                $cost = $cost->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($provider->offPeakMultiplier));
                $offAppl = true;
            }
        }

        $rounded = $cost->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);
        return [
            $cost->toBcString(),
            $rounded->toBcString(),
            $rowEntity->currency,
            $unit,
            $rowEntity->ratesJson,
            $offAppl,
        ];
    }

    private static function exactCost(string $unit, array $rateSpec, TokenUsage $t): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            $total = $t->total();
            if ($total === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$total)
                ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rateSpec['any'] ?? '0'))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }
        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add(self::term($t->input,     $rateSpec['input']      ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->output,    $rateSpec['output']     ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheRead, $rateSpec['cache_read'] ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheWrite,$rateSpec['cache_write']??'0'));
    }

    private static function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

final class RepriceResult
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $ratedCount,
        public readonly int $unratedCount,

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Command;

use App\Application\ApplicationServices;
use App\Application\ImportResult;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Style\SymfonyStyle;

#[AsCommand(name: 'billing:import-prices', description: 'Import the provider/model price book from a JSON file.')]
final class ImportPricesCommand extends Command
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly ApplicationServices $services,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->addArgument('pricesJson', InputArgument::REQUIRED, 'Path to the prices JSON file (fixture: fixtures/prices.json)');
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $io  = new SymfonyStyle($input, $output);
        $path = $input->getArgument('pricesJson');

        if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
            $io->error(sprintf('prices file not found or not readable: %s', $path));
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $json = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($json === false) {
            $io->error('could not read prices file');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $payload = json_decode($json, true);
        if (!is_array($payload)) {
            $io->error('prices file is not a valid JSON object');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $result = $this->services->importPrices($payload);
        $this->renderImportResult($io, $result);

        return $result->errors === [] ? Command::SUCCESS : Command::FAILURE;
    }

    private function renderImportResult(SymfonyStyle $io, ImportResult $result): void
    {
        $io->title('Price book import');
        $io->twoColumnTable(
            ['metric', 'value'],
            [
                ['providers imported', (string) $result->providersCount],
                ['models imported',    (string) $result->modelsCount],
                ['entries rejected',   (string) count($result->errors)],
            ],
        );
        if ($result->errors !== []) {
            $io->warning('Rejected entries:');
            foreach ($result->errors as $e) {
                $io->text('  - ' . $e);
            }
        } else {
            $io->success('Price book imported successfully.');
        }
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ModelEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ProviderEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

final class ApplicationServices
{
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1_000_000;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
    ) {}

    // ── pricing import ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public function importPrices(array $payload): ImportResult
    {
        $errors = [];
        $okProviders = 0;
        $okModels = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        if (!isset($payload['providers']) || !is_array($payload['providers'])) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ['"providers" key required']);
        }

        foreach ($payload['providers'] as $idx => $p) {
            $label = sprintf('providers[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseProvider($p, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $row['code']]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ProviderEntity();
            $entity->code = $row['code'];
            $entity->name = $row['name'];
            $entity->offPeakStartMin   = $row['offPeak']['startMin']   ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakEndMin     = $row['offPeak']['endMin']     ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakMultiplier = $row['offPeak']['multiplier'] ?? null;
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okProviders++;
        }

        if (!isset($payload['models']) || !is_array($payload['models'])) {
            return new ImportResult(
                $okProviders, $okProviders, 0, 0, 0,
                array_merge($errors, ['"models" key required']))
            ;
        }

        $providerCodes = array_filter(array_map(fn($p) => is_array($p) ? ($p['code'] ?? null) : null, $payload['providers']));

        foreach ($payload['models'] as $idx => $m) {
            $label = sprintf('models[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseModel($m, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($row['providerCode'], $providerCodes, true)) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider \"$row[providerCode]\" not in this file";
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode' => $row['providerCode'],
                'code'         => $row['code'],
            ]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ModelEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $row['providerCode'];
            $entity->code         = $row['code'];
            $entity->modelName    = $row['modelName'];
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okModels++;
        }

        // ── price rows ──
        if (isset($payload['price_rows']) && is_array($payload['price_rows'])) {
            foreach ($payload['price_rows'] as $idx => $pr) {
                $label = sprintf('price_rows[%d]', $idx);
                try {
                    self::validatePriceRow($pr, $label);
                } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                    $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                    continue;
                }
                $existing = $this->em->createQuery(
                    'SELECT x FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity x
                     WHERE x.providerCode = :pc AND x.modelCode = :mc AND x.validFrom = :ts'
                )->setParameter('pc', $pr['provider'])
                 ->setParameter('mc', $pr['model_code'])
                 ->setParameter('ts', new \DateTimeImmutable($pr['valid_from']))
                 ->getOneOrNullResult();
                $entity = $existing ?? new PriceRowEntity();
                $entity->providerCode  = $pr['provider'];
                $entity->modelCode     = $pr['model_code'];
                $entity->validFrom     = new \DateTimeImmutable($pr['valid_from']);
                $entity->currency      = $pr['currency'] ?? 'USD';
                $entity->unit          = $pr['unit'];
                $entity->ratesJson     = json_encode($pr['rates'], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
                if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
                $this->em->persist($entity);
            }
        }

        $this->em->flush();
        return new ImportResult($okProviders + $okModels, $okProviders, $okModels, 0, 0, $errors);
    }

    private static function parseProvider(array $p, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($p)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $code = $p['code'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" required");
        $name = $p['name'] ?? $code;
        if (!is_string($name) || $name === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"name\" must be string");

        $offPeak = null;
        if (isset($p['off_peak'])) {
            $op  = $p['off_peak'];
            if (!is_array($op)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak must be object");
            $start = (string)($op['utc_start'] ?? '');
            $end   = (string)($op['utc_end']   ?? '');
            $multi = (string)($op['multiplier'] ?? '');
            if ($start === '' || !preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $start)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_start must be HH:MM");
            if ($end   === '' || !preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $end))   throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.utc_end must be HH:MM");
            if ($multi === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.multiplier required");
            try {
                $w = OffPeakWindow::fromHhmm($start, $end, $multi);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak — {$e->getMessage()}");
            }
            $offPeak = ['startMin' => $w->startMinutes, 'endMin' => $w->endMinutes, 'multiplier' => $multi];
        }

        return ['code' => $code, 'name' => $name, 'offPeak' => $offPeak];
    }

    private static function parseModel(array $m, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($m)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be object");
        $pc   = $m['provider'] ?? null;
        $code = $m['code']     ?? null;
        if (!is_string($pc)   || $pc   === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"provider\" required");
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" required");
        $mn = $m['model_name'] ?? null;
        if ($mn !== null && !is_string($mn)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"model_name\" must be string");

        return ['providerCode' => $pc, 'code' => $code, 'modelName' => $mn];
    }

    private static function validatePriceRow(array $pr, string $label): void
    {
        if (!is_array($pr)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be object");
        foreach (['provider', 'model_code', 'valid_from', 'unit', 'rates'] as $k) {
            if (!isset($pr[$k])) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"$k\" required");
        }
        $pc = $pr['provider'];
        $mc = $pr['model_code'];
        if (!is_string($pc) || $pc === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: provider required");
        if (!is_string($mc) || $mc === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: model_code required");
        if (!is_string($pr['valid_from'])) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: valid_from must be ISO 8601");
        try { new \DateTimeImmutable($pr['valid_from']); } catch (\Exception) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: valid_from invalid date");
        }
        if (!is_array($pr['rates'])) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: rates must be object");
        foreach ($pr['rates'] as $k => $v) {
            if (!is_string($v) && !is_int($v)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: rates.$k must be decimal string");
            $sv = (string)$v;
            if (!preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d{1,6})?$/', $sv)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: rates.$k invalid: $sv");
        }
        if (!preg_match('/^USD$/', $pr['currency'] ?? '')) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: currency must be ISO 4217 (e.g. USD)");
        }
    }

    // ── usage import ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public function importUsage(string $filePath): ImportResult
    {
        if (!is_file($filePath) || !is_readable($filePath)) {
            return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, [sprintf('file not found: %s', $filePath)]);
        }
        $fh = fopen($filePath, 'rb');
        if ($fh === false) return new ImportResult(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, ['could not open file']);

        $errors = [];
        $ok = 0;
        $seen = [];
        $lineNo = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        $utc = new \DateTimeZone('UTC');

        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            $lineNo++;
            $line = trim($line);
            if ($line === '') continue;
            $label = "line $lineNo";

            $obj = json_decode($line, true);
            if (!is_array($obj)) { $errors[] = "$label: invalid JSON"; continue; }

            $pc    = $obj['provider']            ?? null;
            $rid   = $obj['provider_request_id'] ?? null;
            $tsRaw = $obj['ts_utc']              ?? $obj['ts'] ?? null;
            $mc    = $obj['model_code']          ?? $obj['model'] ?? null;

            if (!is_string($pc)   || $pc   === '') { $errors[] = "$label: provider required"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($rid)  || $rid  === '') { $errors[] = "$label: provider_request_id required"; continue; }
            if ($tsRaw === null)                  { $errors[] = "$label: ts_utc required"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($mc)   || $mc   === '') { $errors[] = "$label: model_code required"; continue; }

            try {
                $tsUtc = (new \DateTimeImmutable((string)$tsRaw))->setTimezone($utc);
            } catch (\Exception) { $errors[] = "$label: invalid timestamp $tsRaw"; continue; }

            $key = $pc . "\x00" . $rid;
            if (isset($seen[$key])) { $ok++; continue; }
            $seen[$key] = true;

            if ($this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $pc]) === null) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider $pc not in price book"; continue;
            }
            if ($this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy(['providerCode' => $pc, 'code' => $mc]) === null) {
                $errors[] = "$label: model $mc not found for provider $pc"; continue;
            }

            $tokRaw = $obj['tokens'] ?? $obj['token_usage'] ?? $obj;
            if (!is_array($tokRaw)) { $errors[] = "$label: tokens required"; continue; }

            $pick = function (array $r, array $cands) use ($errors, $label) {
                foreach ($cands as $c) {
                    if (isset($r[$c])) {
                        $v = $r[$c];
                        if (is_int($v) && $v >= 0) return $v;
                        if (is_string($v) && preg_match('/^\d+$/', $v)) return (int)$v;
                    }
                }
                return 0;
            };

            $tokIn  = $pick($tokRaw, ['input', 'prompt_tokens', 'input_tokens', 'prompt']);
            $tokOut = $pick($tokRaw, ['output', 'completion_tokens', 'output_tokens', 'completion']);
            $tokCR  = $pick($tokRaw, ['cache_read', 'cache_read_input_tokens', 'cache_read_tokens']);
            $tokCW  = $pick($tokRaw, ['cache_write', 'cache_write_input_tokens', 'cache_write_tokens']);

            if ($tokIn + $tokOut + $tokCR + $tokCW === 0) {
                $errors[] = "$label: all-zero tokens"; continue;
            }

            $exists = $this->em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode' => $pc, 'providerRequestId' => $rid,
            ]);
            $entity = $exists ?? new UsageEventEntity();
            $entity->providerCode       = $pc;
            $entity->providerRequestId  = $rid;
            $entity->tsUtc              = $tsUtc;
            $entity->modelCode          = $mc;
            $entity->sourceRow          = $lineNo;
            $entity->tokensInput        = $tokIn;
            $entity->tokensOutput       = $tokOut;
            $entity->tokensCacheRead    = $tokCR;
            $entity->tokensCacheWrite   = $tokCW;
            $entity->ratingState        = 'pending';
            $entity->exactCost          = null;
            $entity->cost               = null;
            $entity->currency           = null;
            $entity->rateSpecUnit       = null;
            $entity->rateSpecJson       = null;
            $entity->offPeakApplied     = false;
            $entity->error              = null;
            $entity->updatedAt          = $now;
            if ($exists === null) $this->em->persist($entity);
            $ok++;
        }
        fclose($fh);
        $this->em->flush();
        return new ImportResult($ok, 0, 0, $ok, 0, $errors);
    }

    // ── reprice ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public function reprice(): RepriceResult
    {
        $em  = $this->em;
        $all = $em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findAll();
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        $ok  = 0;
        $unrated = 0;
        $errors  = [];

        foreach ($all as $u) {
            try {
                $res = self::rateEventRow($em, $u);
                if ($res === null) {
                    $u->ratingState = 'unrated';
                    $u->exactCost = null; $u->cost = null;
                    $u->currency = null; $u->rateSpecUnit = null; $u->rateSpecJson = null;
                    $u->offPeakApplied = false; $u->error = null;
                    $unrated++;
                } else {
                    [$exact, $cost, $cur, $unit, $specJson, $offAppl] = $res;
                    $u->ratingState = 'rated';
                    $u->exactCost = $exact; $u->cost = $cost;
                    $u->currency = $cur; $u->rateSpecUnit = $unit; $u->rateSpecJson = $specJson;
                    $u->offPeakApplied = $offAppl; $u->error = null;
                    $ok++;
                }
                $u->updatedAt = $now;
            } catch (\Throwable $e) {
                $u->ratingState = 'error';
                $u->error = $e->getMessage();
                $u->updatedAt = $now;
                $errors[] = sprintf("%s/%s: %s", $u->providerCode, $u->providerRequestId, $e->getMessage());
            }
        }
        $em->flush();
        return new RepriceResult($ok, $unrated, count($errors), $errors);
    }

    private static function rateEventRow(EntityManagerInterface $em, UsageEventEntity $u): ?array
    {
        $rowEntity = $em->createQuery(
            'SELECT r FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity r
             WHERE r.providerCode = :pc AND r.modelCode = :mc AND r.validFrom <= :ts
             ORDER BY r.validFrom DESC'
        )->setParameter('pc', $u->providerCode)
         ->setParameter('mc', $u->modelCode)
         ->setParameter('ts', $u->tsUtc)
         ->setMaxResults(1)
         ->getOneOrNullResult();
        if ($rowEntity === null) return null;

        $rateSpec = json_decode($rowEntity->ratesJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
        $unit     = $rowEntity->unit;
        $tok      = new TokenUsage($u->tokensInput, $u->tokensOutput, $u->tokensCacheRead, $u->tokensCacheWrite);
        $cost     = self::exactCost($unit, $rateSpec, $tok);

        $offAppl = false;
        $provider = $em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $u->providerCode]);
        if ($provider !== null && $provider->offPeakStartMin !== null && $provider->offPeakEndMin !== null && $provider->offPeakMultiplier !== null) {
            $w = new OffPeakWindow($provider->offPeakStartMin, $provider->offPeakEndMin, $provider->offPeakMultiplier);
            $minOfUtc = (int)$u->tsUtc->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'))->format('Hi');
            if ($w->contains($minOfUtc)) {
                $cost = $cost->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($provider->offPeakMultiplier));
                $offAppl = true;
            }
        }

        $rounded = $cost->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);
        return [
            $cost->toBcString(),
            $rounded->toBcString(),
            $rowEntity->currency,
            $unit,
            $rowEntity->ratesJson,
            $offAppl,
        ];
    }

    private static function exactCost(string $unit, array $rateSpec, TokenUsage $t): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            if ($t->total() === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$t->total())
                ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rateSpec['any'] ?? '0'))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }
        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add(self::term($t->input,      $rateSpec['input']      ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->output,     $rateSpec['output']     ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheRead,  $rateSpec['cache_read'] ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheWrite, $rateSpec['cache_write']?? '0'));
    }

    private static function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }
}

# Тестовое задание: учёт расходов на LLM-токены

Задание проверяет умение проектировать доменную логику и писать рабочий код
бэкенда. Мы ожидаем осмысленное предметное моделирование (DDD приветствуется),
аккуратную работу с деньгами и временем, и код, функциональный на базовом
уровне. Ориентир по времени — 4–6 часов; лучше меньше, но работающее, чем
больше и неработающее.

Всё выполняется в этом репозитории. Как поднять окружение — `README.md`
в корне; зависимости уже в `vendor/`.

## Контекст

Сервис перепродаёт доступ к LLM: он платит провайдерам за токены и должен
знать свои расходы в разрезе пользователей и моделей. Данные приходят двумя
потоками:

- **история цен** — справочник: провайдеры, их модели и цены, действовавшие
  с определённых моментов времени;
- **события использования** — журнал фактических запросов к моделям
  (сколько каких токенов израсходовано), поставляемый провайдерами.

Нужно консольное приложение, которое принимает эти данные и считает расходы.
Реальность вносит тонкости — все они зафиксированы в требованиях ниже:

- у провайдеров **разные схемы тарификации** (per-token с разбивкой по видам
  токенов у одного, единая цена за любой токен у другого);
- **цены меняются во времени**: событие тарифицируется ценой, действовавшей
  в его момент, а не текущей;
- у одного провайдера есть **оф-пиковая скидка** в фиксированном окне UTC;
- провайдеры **присылают дубли** событий — двойного списания быть не должно;
- деньги считаются только **точной десятичной арифметикой** (float для
  денег запрещён).

## Входные данные

### История цен — JSON-файл

Пример (сокращённый; полный рабочий пример — `fixtures/prices.json`):

```json
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "code": "prism",
      "name": "Prism AI",
      "off_peak": {
        "window_start": "16:30",
        "window_end": "00:30",
        "multiplier": "0.5"
      }
    },
    { "code": "sfera", "name": "Sfera Cloud", "off_peak": null }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "provider": "prism", "code": "lumen-8" },
    { "provider": "sfera", "code": "gyro-pro" }
  ],
  "prices": [
    {
      "provider": "prism",
      "model": "lumen-8",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens",
      "rates": {
        "input": "3.000000",
        "output": "12.000000",
        "cache_read": "0.300000",
        "cache_write": "3.750000"
      }
    },
    {
      "provider": "sfera",
      "model": "gyro-pro",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens_unified",
      "rates": { "any": "2.400000" }
    }
  ]
}
```

Пояснения:

- `unit` задаёт схему тарификации:
  - `per_1m_tokens` — цена за 1 000 000 токенов отдельно для каждого вида:
    `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`;
  - `per_1m_tokens_unified` — единая цена за 1 000 000 токенов любого вида.
- `off_peak` — окно скидки провайдера по времени суток UTC:
  `window_start` включительно, `window_end` исключительно; окно может
  переходить через полночь (`16:30`–`00:30`); `multiplier` — множитель
  стоимости события, попавшего в окно. `null` — скидки нет.
- у одной модели может быть несколько строк цен с разными `valid_from`;
- `rates` — десятичные строки (не числа JSON), 6 знаков после точки;
- `currency` везде `USD` (поле зарезервировано на будущее).

### События использования — JSONL-файл

Одно событие на строку:

```json
{"provider": "prism", "provider_request_id": "e1", "model": "lumen-8", "user": "u-alice", "ts": "2026-09-15T11:00:00Z", "tokens_input": 1200000, "tokens_output": 800000, "tokens_cache_read": 2500000, "tokens_cache_write": 83333}
```

- `ts` — момент запроса, ISO-8601, всегда UTC (`Z`);
- `user` — идентификатор пользователя (строка), домена пользователей нет;
- `provider_request_id` — идентификатор запроса **со стороны провайдера**;
  вместе с `provider` образует естественный ключ события;
- количество токенов — целые ≥ 0, любые могут быть нулевыми (в т.ч. все).

## Правила тарификации

1. **Выбор цены.** Событие тарифицируется строкой цен своей модели с
   наибольшим `valid_from` ≤ `ts` события (`valid_from` включительно).
   Если такой строки нет — событие **unrated** (см. п. 7).
2. **Схема `per_1m_tokens`** — сумма по видам токенов:
   `cost = Σ tokens_вид × rate_вид / 1 000 000`.
   **Схема `per_1m_tokens_unified`**:
   `cost = (tokens_input + tokens_output + tokens_cache_read + tokens_cache_write) × rate_any / 1 000 000`.
3. **Оф-пик.** Если время суток `ts` (UTC) попадает в окно `[window_start, window_end)`
   провайдера события — стоимость всего события умножается на `multiplier`.
   Окно задаётся на уровне провайдера и действует для всех его моделей;
   отсутствие `off_peak` означает отсутствие скидки.
4. **Точность вычислений.** Все промежуточные вычисления — без округления
   (десятичная арифметика с запасом точности, например bcmath с масштабом
   ≥ 16). Округление ровно одно: итоговая стоимость **события** округляется
   до 6 знаков после точки по правилу HALF_UP (2.5 → 3). Суммы отчёта —
   сумма уже округлённых стоимостей событий, без повторного округления
   слагаемых. Тип float для денег использовать запрещено.
5. **Идемпотентность приёма.** События дедуплицируются по ключу
   `(provider, provider_request_id)`: повторная доставка уже известного
   события целиком игнорируется (никаких обновлений, никаких доначислений).
   Одинаковые `provider_request_id` у разных провайдеров — это разные
   события.
6. **Период отчёта.** `--from` включительно, `--to` исключительно.
7. **Unrated-события.** Не считаются ошибкой: не тарифицируются, в отчёт
   не попадают. Каждый запуск тарификации повторяет попытку для всех
   ещё не рассчитанных событий (цены могли подтянуться позже).

## Команды

Все команды — через `bin/console`. Вывод отчёта — строго в stdout,
служебные сообщения — в stderr.

### `app:prices:import <file>`

Загружает провайдеров, модели и строки цен. Идемпотентный upsert:
провайдеры — по `code`; модели — по `(provider, code)`; строки цен — по
`(provider, model, valid_from)` (повторная загрузка тех же сумм — не
изменяет данных). Код выхода 0. Некорректный JSON — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:usage:import <file>`

Загружает события по правилу п. 5. Код выхода 0 даже если все строки —
дубли. Некорректная строка JSONL — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:billing:rate`

Тарифицирует все ещё не рассчитанные события (включая повторные попытки
unrated). В stdout — сводка одной строкой: `RATED=<n> UNRATED=<m>`, где
n и m — количества событий, рассчитанных и оставшихся unrated **в этом
запуске**. Для каждого unrated-события этого запуска — строка в stderr:
`UNRATED <provider>/<provider_request_id> <ts> no_price`. Код выхода 0.

### `app:billing:report [--from=<iso>] [--to=<iso>]`

CSV в stdout (кодировка UTF-8, разделитель `,`, перевод строки `\n`):

```
user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd
u-alice,prism/lumen-8,1200000,800000,2500000,83333,14.262499
u-alice,sfera/gyro-pro,3000000,500000,0,0,8.400000
u-bob,prism/lumen-8,2000000,1000000,0,0,11.000000
TOTAL,,6200000,2300000,2500000,83333,33.662499
```

Требования к формату:

- первая строка — заголовок, точно как в примере;
- строки данных — по одной на пару (user, model), отсортированные по
  `user`, затем по `model` (лексикографически, по возрастанию);
- `model` — `<provider>/<code>` (например `prism/lumen-8`);
- количества токенов — суммы по событиям группы, целые без разделителей;
- `cost_usd` — сумма стоимостей событий группы, ровно 6 знаков после
  точки;
- последняя строка — `TOTAL` с пустым полем `model` и суммами по отчёту;
- unrated-события в отчёт не попадают никогда.

`--from`/`--to` — ISO-8601 (UTC), применяются к `ts` событий по п. 6;
без опций отчёт покрывает все события.

## Пример расчёта

Файлы этого примера лежат в `fixtures/` (`prices.json`, `usage.jsonl`) —
воспроизведите его сами. Три события:

| id | событие | разбор |
|----|---------|--------|
| e1 | prism/lumen-8, alice, `2026-09-15T11:00:00Z`, in 1 200 000, out 800 000, cr 2 500 000, cw 83 333 | цена — строка с 2026-08-01 (смена цены в 12:00 ещё не наступила); 11:00 — пик. Точная стоимость: `1.2M×3 + 0.8M×12 + 2.5M×0.3 + 83333×3.75/1M = 3.6 + 9.6 + 0.75 + 0.31249875 = 14.26249875` → округление события → **14.262499** |
| e2 | prism/lumen-8, bob, `2026-09-15T12:00:00Z`, in 2 000 000, out 1 000 000 | `12:00:00` — момент смены цены, действует новая строка (`valid_from` включительно): `2M×1.5 + 1M×8 = 11.000000` |
| e3 | sfera/gyro-pro, alice, `2026-09-20T17:10:00Z`, in 3 000 000, out 500 000 | unified: `3.5M×2.4 = 8.400000`; у sfera нет оф-пик — время суток не важно |

Отчёт за сентябрь (`--from 2026-09-01T00:00:00Z --to 2026-10-01T00:00:00Z`)
должен выдать в точности:

```
user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd
u-alice,prism/lumen-8,1200000,800000,2500000,83333,14.262499
u-alice,sfera/gyro-pro,3000000,500000,0,0,8.400000
u-bob,prism/lumen-8,2000000,1000000,0,0,11.000000
TOTAL,,6200000,2300000,2500000,83333,33.662499
```

## Требования

- PHP 8.4+, Symfony, PostgreSQL 17, Doctrine ORM. Каркас приложения уже
  настроен (`bin/console` работает, docker-compose для PostgreSQL — в
  `docker-compose.yml`, `Makefile` — типовые операции).
- Схема БД должна разворачиваться на чистой базе: после разворачивания
  все команды работают. Способ управления схемой — на ваше усмотрение.
- Архитектура, разбиение на слои/модули, именование — на ваше усмотрение
  (это предмет оценки). Тесты (в `vendor/` есть PHPUnit) — плюс, но не
  обязательны.
- Файлы каркаса (`TASK.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `fixtures/`,
  `composer.json` / `composer.lock`, `docker-compose.yml`, `Makefile`,
  `phpunit.xml.dist`) менять не требуется. Если сочтёте нужным что-то
  изменить — меняйте и объясните причину в `PR_DESCRIPTION.md`.
- Неоговорённые детали — принимайте решения самостоятельно и фиксируйте
  допущения там же.

## За рамками задачи (не делать)

UI, HTTP API, реальные вызовы провайдеров, аутентификация, домен
пользователей, платежи/тарифные планы/промокоды, удаление или ручная
правка истории событий, очереди/воркеры, интерактивные диалоги.

## Бонус (по желанию, оценивается отдельно)

**Ретро-коррекция цены.** Провайдер сообщил, что цена, действовавшая с
некоторого `valid_from`, была неверной, и присылает исправленную строку
(файл того же формата). Уже рассчитанные события трогать молча нельзя —
расходы показаны пользователю. Реализуйте команду:

```
bin/console app:billing:reprice <file>
```
