<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Application;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ModelEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\ProviderEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity;
use App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity;
use Doctrine\ORM\EntityManagerInterface;

final class ApplicationServices
{
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1_000_000;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly EntityManagerInterface $em,
    ) {}

    // ── pricing import ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * @param array $payload decoded JSON (must have "providers", "models", "prices" keys)
     * @throws \RuntimeException on invalid payload shape
     */
    public function importPrices(array $payload): ImportResult
    {
        $errors = [];
        $okProviders = 0;
        $okModels = 0;
        $okPrices = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        $utc = new \DateTimeZone('UTC');

        // ── providers ──
        if (!isset($payload['providers']) || !is_array($payload['providers'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('"providers" top-level key required (array)');
        }
        foreach ($payload['providers'] as $idx => $p) {
            $label = sprintf('providers[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseProvider($p, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $row['code']]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ProviderEntity();
            $entity->code = $row['code'];
            $entity->name = $row['name'];
            $entity->offPeakStartMin   = $row['offPeak']['startMin']   ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakEndMin     = $row['offPeak']['endMin']     ?? null;
            $entity->offPeakMultiplier = $row['offPeak']['multiplier'] ?? null;
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okProviders++;
        }

        // ── models ──
        if (!isset($payload['models']) || !is_array($payload['models'])) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('"models" top-level key required (array)');
        }
        $providerCodes = array_filter(array_map(
            fn($p) => is_array($p) && isset($p['code']) ? $p['code'] : null,
            $payload['providers']));
        foreach ($payload['models'] as $idx => $m) {
            $label = sprintf('models[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $row = self::parseModel($m, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            if (!in_array($row['providerCode'], $providerCodes, true)) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider {$row[providerCode]} not declared in providers section";
                continue;
            }
            $existing = $this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode' => $row['providerCode'], 'code' => $row['code'],
            ]);
            $entity = $existing ?? new ModelEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $row['providerCode'];
            $entity->code         = $row['code'];
            $entity->modelName    = $row['modelName'];
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okModels++;
        }

        // ── price rows ──
        $priceRows = $payload['prices'] ?? $payload['price_rows'] ?? [];
        if ($priceRows !== [] && !is_array($priceRows)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('"prices" must be an array');
        }
        foreach ($priceRows as $idx => $pr) {
            $label = sprintf('prices[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $r = self::parsePriceRow($pr, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                $errors[] = $e->getMessage();
                continue;
            }
            $validFrom = new \DateTimeImmutable($r['validFrom']);
            $existing = $this->em->createQuery(
                'SELECT x FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity x
                 WHERE x.providerCode = :pc AND x.modelCode = :mc AND x.validFrom = :ts'
            )->setParameter('pc', $r['provider'])->setParameter('mc', $r['model'])->setParameter('ts', $validFrom)
              ->getOneOrNullResult();
            $entity = $existing ?? new PriceRowEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $r['provider'];
            $entity->modelCode    = $r['model'];
            $entity->validFrom    = $validFrom;
            $entity->currency     = $r['currency'];
            $entity->unit         = $r['unit'];
            $entity->ratesJson    = json_encode($r['rates'], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $okPrices++;
        }

        $this->em->flush();
        return new ImportResult(
            importedCount: $okProviders + $okModels + $okPrices,
            providers:     $okProviders,
            models:        $okModels,
            prices:        $okPrices,
            usageEvents:   0,
            errors:        $errors,
        );
    }

    private static function parseProvider(array $p, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($p)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $code = $p['code'] ?? null;
        if (!is_string($code) || $code === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" required");
        $name = $p['name'] ?? $code;
        if (!is_string($name) || $name === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"name\" must be non-empty string");

        $offPeak = null;
        if (isset($p['off_peak']) && $p['off_peak'] !== null) {
            $op = $p['off_peak'];
            if (!is_array($op)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak must be an object");
            $startRaw = $op['window_start'] ?? null;
            $endRaw   = $op['window_end']   ?? null;
            $multi    = $op['multiplier']   ?? null;
            if (!is_string($startRaw) || !preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $startRaw)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.window_start must be HH:MM (string)");
            if (!is_string($endRaw)   || !preg_match('/^\d{1,2}:\d{2}$/', $endRaw))   throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.window_end must be HH:MM (string)");
            if ($multi === null)                                          throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.multiplier required");
            if (is_string($multi)) {
                if (!preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d{1,6})?$/', $multi)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.multiplier must be decimal string (≤6 dp)");
            } elseif (!is_numeric($multi)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak.multiplier must be a string or number");
            } else {
                $multi = (string)$multi;
            }
            try {
                $w = OffPeakWindow::fromHhmm($startRaw, $endRaw, (string)$multi);
                $offPeak = ['startMin' => $w->startMinutes, 'endMin' => $w->endMinutes, 'multiplier' => (string)$multi];
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException $e) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: off_peak — {$e->getMessage()}");
            }
        }

        return ['code' => $code, 'name' => $name, 'offPeak' => $offPeak];
    }

    private static function parseModel(array $m, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($m)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $pc = $m['provider'] ?? null;
        $c  = $m['code']     ?? null;
        if (!is_string($pc) || $pc === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"provider\" required");
        if (!is_string($c)  || $c  === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"code\" required");
        $mn = $m['model_name'] ?? null;
        if ($mn !== null && !is_string($mn)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"model_name\" must be string");

        return ['providerCode' => $pc, 'code' => $c, 'modelName' => $mn];
    }

    private static function parsePriceRow(array $pr, string $label): array
    {
        if (!is_array($pr)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: must be an object");
        $pc = $pr['provider'] ?? null;
        $mc = $pr['model']    ?? $pr['model_code'] ?? null;
        $vf = $pr['valid_from'] ?? null;
        $cur = $pr['currency'] ?? null;
        $unit = $pr['unit'] ?? null;
        $rates = $pr['rates'] ?? null;

        if (!is_string($pc)   || $pc   === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"provider\" required");
        if (!is_string($mc)   || $mc   === '') throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"model\" required");
        if ($vf === null)                       throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"valid_from\" required");
        if ($cur !== null && !is_string($cur))  throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"currency\" must be string");
        if (!is_string($unit) || $unit === '')  throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"unit\" required");
        if (!is_array($rates) || $rates === []) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: \"rates\" must be non-empty object");

        try {
            new \DateTimeImmutable((string)$vf);
        } catch (\Exception) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: valid_from not a valid ISO-8601 date");
        }

        $unit = (string)$unit;
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            if (!array_key_exists('any', $rates)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: unified rate must define \"any\"");
        } elseif ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens') {
            foreach (['input','output','cache_read','cache_write'] as $k) {
                if (!array_key_exists($k, $rates)) throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: per_1m_tokens must define rate \"$k\"");
            }
        } else {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: unknown unit $unit");
        }

        foreach ($rates as $k => $v) {
            $sv = is_string($v) ? $v : (string)$v;
            if (!preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d{1,6})?$/', $sv)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException("$label: rates.$k invalid: $sv");
            }
            $rates[$k] = $sv;
        }

        return [
            'provider' => $pc, 'model' => $mc,
            'validFrom' => (string)$vf,
            'currency' => $cur ?? 'USD',
            'unit' => $unit,
            'rates' => $rates,
        ];
    }

    // ── usage import ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    public function importUsage(string $filePath): ImportResult
    {
        if (!is_file($filePath) || !is_readable($filePath)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException(sprintf('not found or not readable: %s', $filePath));
        }
        $fh = fopen($filePath, 'rb');
        if ($fh === false) throw new \RuntimeException('could not open file for reading');

        $errors = [];
        $ok = 0;
        $dups = 0;
        $lineNo = 0;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        $utc = new \DateTimeZone('UTC');
        $seen = []; // pc\x00rid => true (session-level dedup)

        while (($line = fgets($fh)) !== false) {
            $lineNo++;
            $line = trim($line);
            if ($line === '') continue;
            $label = "line $lineNo";

            $obj = json_decode($line, true);
            if (!is_array($obj)) { $errors[] = "$label: not valid JSON"; continue; }

            $pc = $obj['provider'] ?? null;
            $rid = $obj['provider_request_id'] ?? null;
            $tsRaw = $obj['ts'] ?? $obj['ts_utc'] ?? null;
            $mc = $obj['model'] ?? $obj['model_code'] ?? null;
            $user = $obj['user'] ?? null;

            if (!is_string($pc)   || $pc   === '') { $errors[] = "$label: provider required"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($rid)  || $rid  === '') { $errors[] = "$label: provider_request_id required"; continue; }
            if ($tsRaw === null)                   { $errors[] = "$label: ts required"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($mc)   || $mc   === '') { $errors[] = "$label: model required"; continue; }
            if (!is_string($user) || $user === '') { $errors[] = "$label: user required"; continue; }

            try {
                $tsUtc = (new \DateTimeImmutable((string)$tsRaw, $utc));
            } catch (\Exception) { $errors[] = "$label: invalid ts: $tsRaw"; continue; }
            $tsUtc = $tsUtc->setTimezone($utc);

            $key = $pc . "\x00" . $rid;
            if (isset($seen[$key])) { $dups++; continue; }
            $seen[$key] = true;

            // provider + model must exist in DB
            if ($this->em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $pc]) === null) {
                $errors[] = "$label: provider $pc not in price book"; continue;
            }
            if ($this->em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy(['providerCode' => $pc, 'code' => $mc]) === null) {
                $errors[] = "$label: model $mc not found for provider $pc"; continue;
            }

            // token fields — direct keys in the row
            $pickInt = fn(array $o, string $k): int => match(true) {
                is_int($o[$k] ?? null) => $o[$k],
                is_string($o[$k] ?? null) && preg_match('/^\d+$/', $o[$k]) => (int)$o[$k],
                true => 0,
            };
            $tokIn  = $pickInt($obj, 'tokens_input');
            $tokOut = $pickInt($obj, 'tokens_output');
            $tokCR  = $pickInt($obj, 'tokens_cache_read');
            $tokCW  = $pickInt($obj, 'tokens_cache_write');
            if ($tokIn + $tokOut + $tokCR + $tokCW === 0) {
                $errors[] = "$label: all-zero token counts"; continue;
            }

            // DB-level dedup: if already in DB from a previous run, skip
            $exists = $this->em->getRepository(UsageEventEntity::class)->findOneBy([
                'providerCode' => $pc, 'providerRequestId' => $rid,
            ]);
            if ($exists !== null) { $dups++; continue; }

            $entity = new UsageEventEntity();
            $entity->providerCode       = $pc;
            $entity->providerRequestId  = $rid;
            $entity->user               = $user;
            $entity->tsUtc              = $tsUtc;
            $entity->modelCode          = $mc;
            $entity->tokensInput        = $tokIn;
            $entity->tokensOutput       = $tokOut;
            $entity->tokensCacheRead    = $tokCR;
            $entity->tokensCacheWrite   = $tokCW;
            $entity->ratingState        = 'pending';
            $entity->currency           = null;
            $entity->rateSpecUnit       = null;
            $entity->rateSpecJson       = null;
            $entity->exactCost          = null;
            $entity->cost               = null;
            $entity->offPeakApplied     = false;
            $entity->updatedAt          = $now;
            $this->em->persist($entity);
            $ok++;
        }
        fclose($fh);
        $this->em->flush();

        if ($errors !== [] && $ok === 0) {
            // all lines failed → treat as fatal
            throw new \RuntimeException(implode(' ', $errors));
        }

        return new ImportResult(
            importedCount: $ok,
            providers: 0, models: 0, prices: 0,
            usageEvents: $ok,
            errors: $errors,
        );
    }

    // ── reprice (rate) ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * Rate all pending + unrated events. Returns RepriceResult.
     */
    public function rate(): RepriceResult
    {
        $em = $this->em;
        $utc = new \DateTimeZone('UTC');
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', $utc);

        // events to rate: state is 'pending' (new) or 'unrated' (re-try)
        $events = $em->createQuery(
            'SELECT e FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity e
             WHERE e.ratingState IN (\'pending\', \'unrated\')
             ORDER BY e.providerCode ASC, e.providerRequestId ASC'
        )->getResult();

        $ok = 0;
        $unrated = 0;
        $stderr = []; // per-event details

        foreach ($events as $u) {
            $rowEntity = $em->createQuery(
                'SELECT r FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity r
                 WHERE r.providerCode = :pc AND r.modelCode = :mc AND r.validFrom <= :ts
                 ORDER BY r.validFrom DESC'
            )->setParameter('pc', $u->providerCode)
             ->setParameter('mc', $u->modelCode)
             ->setParameter('ts', $u->tsUtc)
             ->setMaxResults(1)
             ->getOneOrNullResult();

            if ($rowEntity === null) {
                $u->ratingState = 'unrated';
                $u->exactCost = null;
                $u->cost = null;
                $u->currency = null;
                $u->rateSpecUnit = null;
                $u->rateSpecJson = null;
                $u->offPeakApplied = false;
                $u->updatedAt = $now;
                $stderr[] = sprintf('UNRATED %s/%s %s no_price',
                    $u->providerCode, $u->providerRequestId,
                    $u->tsUtc->format(\DateTimeInterface::ATOM));
                $unrated++;
                continue;
            }

            $rateSpec = json_decode($rowEntity->ratesJson, true, 512, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            $unit     = $rowEntity->unit;
            $tok      = new TokenUsage($u->tokensInput, $u->tokensOutput, $u->tokensCacheRead, $u->tokensCacheWrite);

            $cost = self::exactCost($unit, $rateSpec, $tok);

            // off-peak
            $offAppl = false;
            $provider = $em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $u->providerCode]);
            if ($provider !== null
                && $provider->offPeakStartMin !== null
                && $provider->offPeakEndMin   !== null
                && $provider->offPeakMultiplier !== null
            ) {
                $w = new OffPeakWindow(
                    $provider->offPeakStartMin,
                    $provider->offPeakEndMin,
                    $provider->offPeakMultiplier,
                );
                $minOfDay = (int)$u->tsUtc->format('Hi');
                if ($w->contains($minOfDay)) {
                    $cost = $cost->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($provider->offPeakMultiplier));
                    $offAppl = true;
                }
            }

            $rounded = $cost->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);

            $u->ratingState  = 'rated';
            $u->exactCost    = $cost->toBcString();
            $u->cost         = $rounded->toBcString();
            $u->currency     = $rowEntity->currency;
            $u->rateSpecUnit = $unit;
            $u->rateSpecJson = $rowEntity->ratesJson;
            $u->offPeakApplied = $offAppl;
            $u->updatedAt    = $now;
            $ok++;
        }

        $em->flush();
        return new RepriceResult($ok, $unrated, 0, $stderr);
    }

    // ── report ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    /**
     * @param \DateTimeImmutable|null $from inclusive
     * @param \DateTimeImmutable|null $to   exclusive
     * @return array rows + totals
     */
    public function reportRange(?\DateTimeImmutable $from, ?\DateTimeImmutable $to): array
    {
        $em = $this->em;
        $params = [];

        $qb = $em->createQuery(
            'SELECT e FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity e WHERE e.ratingState = \'rated\''
        );
        if ($from !== null) { $qb->andWhere('e.tsUtc >= :from'); $params['from'] = $from; }
        if ($to   !== null) { $qb->andWhere('e.tsUtc <  :to');   $params['to']   = $to; }
        foreach ($params as $k => $v) { $qb->setParameter($k, $v); }

        $events = $qb->orderBy('e.user', 'ASC')->addOrderBy('e.modelCode', 'ASC')
                     ->addOrderBy('e.providerCode', 'ASC')
                     ->getResult();

        $groups = []; // "user|provider/model" => [...counts]
        $totals = ['input' => 0, 'output' => 0, 'cache_read' => 0, 'cache_write' => 0, 'cost' => DecimalMoney::zero()];

        foreach ($events as $e) {
            $model = $e->providerCode . '/' . $e->modelCode;
            $key = $e->user . "\x00" . $model;
            if (!isset($groups[$key])) {
                $groups[$key] = [
                    'user' => $e->user, 'model' => $model,
                    'input' => 0, 'output' => 0, 'cache_read' => 0, 'cache_write' => 0,
                    'cost' => DecimalMoney::zero(),
                ];
            }
            $groups[$key]['input']      += $e->tokensInput;
            $groups[$key]['output']     += $e->tokensOutput;
            $groups[$key]['cache_read'] += $e->tokensCacheRead;
            $groups[$key]['cache_write']+= $e->tokensCacheWrite;
            $groups[$key]['cost']       = $groups[$key]['cost']->add(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($e->cost));

            $totals['input']      += $e->tokensInput;
            $totals['output']     += $e->tokensOutput;
            $totals['cache_read'] += $e->tokensCacheRead;
            $totals['cache_write']+= $e->tokensCacheWrite;
            $totals['cost']       = $totals['cost']->add(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($e->cost));
        }

        usort($groups, fn($a, $b) => strcasecmp($a['user'] . "\x00" . $a['model'], $b['user'] . "\x00" . $b['model']));

        return ['groups' => array_values($groups), 'totals' => $totals];
    }

    // ── reprice bonus: app:billing:reprice ─────────────────────────────────────

    public function repriceFile(array $payload): RepriceResult
    {
        // 1. Upsert the new price rows (same logic as importPrices "prices" section).
        // 2. Find all rated events whose rateSpec matches a replaced row (same provider, model, valid_from).
        // 3. Re-rate those events; compute delta.

        $em = $this->em;
        $now = new \DateTimeImmutable('now', new \DateTimeZone('UTC'));

        $oldCosts = []; // event id => old cost string

        $priceRows = $payload['prices'] ?? [];
        $replaced = []; // list of [provider, model, validFrom]

        foreach ($priceRows as $idx => $pr) {
            $label = sprintf('prices[%d]', $idx);
            try {
                $r = self::parsePriceRow($pr, $label);
            } catch (\InvalidArgumentException) {
                // skip bad rows in a reprice file (only the good ones replace)
                continue;
            }
            $validFrom = new \DateTimeImmutable($r['validFrom']);

            // verify provider+model exist
            if ($em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $r['provider']]) === null) continue;
            if ($em->getRepository(ModelEntity::class)->findOneBy(['providerCode' => $r['provider'], 'code' => $r['model']]) === null) continue;

            $existing = $em->createQuery(
                'SELECT x FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\PriceRowEntity x
                 WHERE x.providerCode = :pc AND x.modelCode = :mc AND x.validFrom = :ts'
            )->setParameter('pc', $r['provider'])->setParameter('mc', $r['model'])->setParameter('ts', $validFrom)
              ->getOneOrNullResult();

            $entity = $existing ?? new PriceRowEntity();
            $entity->providerCode = $r['provider'];
            $entity->modelCode    = $r['model'];
            $entity->validFrom    = $validFrom;
            $entity->currency     = $r['currency'];
            $entity->unit         = $r['unit'];
            $entity->ratesJson    = json_encode($r['rates'], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR);
            if ($existing === null) $entity->createdAt = $now;
            $em->persist($entity);
            $replaced[] = [$r['provider'], $r['model'], $validFrom];
        }
        $em->flush();

        // Find events that were rated using one of the replaced rows
        // An event was rated with row X if: X.providerCode = event.providerCode
        // AND X.modelCode = event.modelCode AND X.validFrom <= event.tsUtc
        // AND X is the most recent row at event.tsUtc (i.e. no other row with validFrom in (X.validFrom, event.tsUtc])
        // Simplified: for each replaced row, find events whose rateSpecJson matches that row's (provider, model, valid_from).

        $recounted = 0;
        $delta = DecimalMoney::zero();

        foreach ($replaced as [$provider, $model, $validFrom]) {
            // find events that were using this exact row (identified by rateSpecJson containing provider+model)
            // We can't easily query by JSON content, so we fetch all rated events for this provider+model
            // and re-evaluate which were actually using this row.

            $events = $em->createQuery(
                'SELECT e FROM App\Infrastructure\Doctrine\UsageEventEntity e
                 WHERE e.ratingState = \'rated\'
                   AND e.providerCode = :pc AND e.modelCode = :mc
                 ORDER BY e.tsUtc ASC'
            )->setParameter('pc', $provider)->setParameter('mc', $model)->getResult();

            foreach ($events as $e) {
                // Determine if this event was rated under the replaced row.
                // The event's rateSpecJson should match this row — but after upsert, the row is new.
                // We need to check if the OLD row (before replacement) was the in-force price at e.tsUtc.
                // Practically: re-rate using the NEW book, but only if the event's old row was the replaced one.
                // For this implementation we re-rate ALL events for this provider/model that have tsUtc >= validFrom
                // AND whose "best price at ts" was the replaced row.

                // Simple heuristic: re-rate if e.tsUtc >= validFrom AND the event's old cost doesn't already match
                // the new row. We can just re-rate and compute delta vs stored cost.
                $newRow = $em->createQueryBuilder()
                    ->select('r')->from(PriceRowEntity::class, 'r')
                    ->where('r.providerCode = :pc')->andWhere('r.modelCode = :mc')
                    ->andWhere('r.validFrom <= :ts')->orderBy('r.validFrom', 'DESC')
                    ->setParameter('pc', $provider)->setParameter('mc', $model)->setParameter('ts', $e->tsUtc)
                    ->setMaxResults(1)->getQuery()->getOneOrNullResult();

                if ($newRow === null) continue;
                // Only re-rate if this was the row that was replaced (validFrom matches)
                if ($newRow->validFrom->format('Y-m-d\TH:i:s') !== $validFrom->format('Y-m-d\TH:i:s')) continue;

                $oldCost = $e->cost !== null ? DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($e->cost) : DecimalMoney::zero();
                $tok = new TokenUsage($e->tokensInput, $e->tokensOutput, $e->tokensCacheRead, $e->tokensCacheWrite);
                $newCost = self::exactCost($newRow->unit, json_decode($newRow->ratesJson, true), $tok);

                // apply off-peak
                $offAppl = false;
                $prov = $em->getRepository(ProviderEntity::class)->findOneBy(['code' => $provider]);
                if ($prov !== null && $prov->offPeakStartMin !== null && $prov->offPeakEndMin !== null && $prov->offPeakMultiplier !== null) {
                    $w = new OffPeakWindow($prov->offPeakStartMin, $prov->offPeakEndMin, $prov->offPeakMultiplier);
                    if ($w->contains((int)$e->tsUtc->format('Hi'))) {
                        $newCost = $newCost->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($prov->offPeakMultiplier));
                        $offAppl = true;
                    }
                }
                $newRounded = $newCost->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);
                $delta = $delta->add($newRounded->subtract($oldCost));

                $e->exactCost      = $newCost->toBcString();
                $e->cost           = $newRounded->toBcString();
                $e->rateSpecUnit   = $newRow->unit;
                $e->rateSpecJson   = $newRow->ratesJson;
                $e->offPeakApplied = $offAppl;
                $e->updatedAt      = $now;
                $recounted++;
            }
        }
        $em->flush();

        return new RepriceResult($recounted, 0, 0, []);
    }

    // ── static helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    private static function exactCost(string $unit, array $rateSpec, TokenUsage $t): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            if ($t->total() === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$t->total())
                ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rateSpec['any'] ?? '0'))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }
        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add(self::term($t->input,      $rateSpec['input']      ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->output,     $rateSpec['output']     ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheRead,  $rateSpec['cache_read'] ?? '0'))
            ->add(self::term($t->cacheWrite, $rateSpec['cache_write']?? '0'));
    }

    private static function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) return DecimalMoney::zero();
        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string)$tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Billing;

use App\Domain\Money\DecimalMoney;
use App\Domain\Pricing\OffPeakWindow;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceBook;
use App\Domain\Pricing\PriceRow;
use App\Domain\Usage\TokenUsage;

/**
 * Pure billing rules (no I/O):
 *  - resolve the price row in force at the event timestamp (most recent validFrom ≤ ts);
 *  - no row ⇒ the event is unrated, not an error;
 *  - compute the exact (unrounded) cost from the row's decimal rates
 *    (tokens × rate ÷ 1 000 000 per "per_1m_tokens" unit);
 *  - apply the provider off-peak multiplier to the total event cost when the
 *    event's UTC time-of-day falls in the window;
 *  - single, final rounding to 6 digits (HALF_UP, 2.5 → 3).
 *
 * No floating point anywhere in this path.
 */
final class BillingEngine
{
    /** "per_1m_tokens" ⇒ rate is per 1 000 000 tokens. */
    public const TOKENS_PER_UNIT = 1000000;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly PriceBook $book,
    ) {
    }

    public function rateEvent(
        string $providerCode,
        string $modelCode,
        \DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc,
        TokenUsage $tokens,
    ): RatingResult {
        $row = $this->book->rateInForce($providerCode, $modelCode, $tsUtc);
        if ($row === null) {
            return RatingResult::unrated($providerCode, $modelCode);
        }

        $exact = $this->exactCost($row, $tokens);

        $offPeak = $this->book->providerOffPeak($providerCode);
        $offPeakApplied = false;
        if ($offPeak !== null && $offPeak->inWindow($this->utcMinutesOfDay($tsUtc))) {
            $exact = $exact->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($offPeak->multiplier));
            $offPeakApplied = true;
        }

        $cost = $exact->roundTo(DecimalMoney::ROUND_SCALE);

        return new RatingResult(
            rating: RatingStatus::RATED,
            providerCode: $providerCode,
            modelCode: $modelCode,
            priceRow: $row,
            offPeak: $offPeakApplied ? $offPeak : null,
            offPeakApplied: $offPeakApplied,
            exactCost: $exact,
            cost: $cost,
        );
    }

    private function exactCost(PriceRow $row, TokenUsage $t): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($row->isUnified()) {
            return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $t->total())
                ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($row->rate('any')))
                ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
        }

        return DecimalMoney::zero()
            ->add($this->term($t->input, $row->rate('input')))
            ->add($this->term($t->output, $row->rate('output')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheRead, $row->rate('cache_read')))
            ->add($this->term($t->cacheWrite, $row->rate('cache_write')));
    }

    private function term(int $tokens, string $rate): DecimalMoney
    {
        if ($tokens === 0) {
            return DecimalMoney::zero();
        }

        return DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString((string) $tokens)
            ->multiply(DecimalMoney::fromDecimalString($rate))
            ->divideByInteger(self::TOKENS_PER_UNIT);
    }

    private function utcMinutesOfDay(\DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc): int
    {
        return (int) $tsUtc->setTimezone(new \DateTimeZone('UTC'))->format('Hi');
    }
}

 *    ROUND_SCALE = 6 digits, applied once to the exact per-event cost.

    }

            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Invalid decimal value: "%s"', $value));

        return new self($value);
    }

    {
        return new self('0');
    }

    {

    }

    public function isNegative(): bool
    {
        return str_starts_with($this->value, '-') && !self::valueIsZero($this->value);
    }

    public function add(self $other): self
    {
        return new self(self::sum($this->value, $other->value));
    }

    public function subtract(self $other): self
    {
        return new self(self::sum($this->value, self::negate($other->value)));

    public function multiply(self $other): self

        return new self(self::mul($this->value, $other->value));

    }

    /**
     * $a ÷ $n (n ≠ 0), exact where the quotient is a terminating decimal with
     * ≤ WORK_SCALE fractional digits — the only case the domain needs
     * ("tokens · rate" ÷ 1 000 000).
     */
    private static function divInt(string $a, int $n): string
    {
        $neg = str_starts_with($a, '-');
        $mag = ltrim($a, '-');
        if (self::valueIsZero($mag)) {
            return '0';
        }
        if ($n === 1) {
            return self::canonical(($neg ? '-' : '') . $mag);
        }

        $dot = strpos($mag, '.');
        $int = $dot === false ? $mag : substr($mag, 0, $dot);
        $frac = $dot === false ? '' : substr($mag, $dot + 1);

        $scale = max(self::WORK_SCALE, strlen($frac));
        $scaled = ltrim($int . $frac . str_repeat('0', $scale - strlen($frac)), '0');
        if ($scaled === '') {
            return '0';
        }
        $ns = (string) abs($n);
        $q = bcdiv($scaled, $ns, 0);
        $r = bcmod($scaled, $ns);
        if ($r !== '0') {
            throw new \DivisionByZeroError('Non-exact division (not expected in this domain): ' . $a . ' / ' . $n);
        }

        $q = str_pad($q, $scale + 1, '0', STR_PAD_LEFT);
        $len = strlen($q);
        $intPart = substr($q, 0, $len - $scale);
        $fracPart = substr($q, $len - $scale);
        $intPart = ltrim($intPart, '0');
        $fracPart = rtrim($fracPart, '0');
        if ($intPart === '') {
            $intPart = '0';
        }
        if ($intPart === '0' && $fracPart === '') {
            return '0';
        }

        return self::canonical(($neg ? '-' : '') . $intPart . ($fracPart !== '' ? '.' . $fracPart : ''));
    }
}

summary:
## Goal
Build a PHP/Symfony console application for LLM token billing cost tracking. The app must ingest usage data (JSONL), price data (JSON), calculate costs using exact decimal arithmetic (no floats), apply off-peak discounts, and provide CLI commands for importing, rating, and reporting. It must handle edge cases like negative results, varying token counts, and provider-specific off-peak windows.

## Constraints & Preferences
- **Language**: PHP 8.4+ (supports `readonly` properties, enums, named arguments).
- **Framework**: Symfony Console, Doctrine ORM.
- **Precision**: No floating-point arithmetic in cost calculation paths. Must use exact rational/decimal arithmetic (BCMath).
- **Rounding**: Costs must be rounded to 6 decimal places using `HALF_UP` (e.g., `0.0000025` → `0.000003`).
- **Domain Logic**:
    - **Off-Peak**: Applies if the event timestamp's UTC time-of-day falls within a provider-specific window. The window can cross midnight.
    - **Pricing**: Two models: `per_1m_tokens` (split into input/output/cache) and `per_1m_tokens_unified` (single `any` rate).
    - **Timezone**: All timestamps are UTC.
- **CLI**: Commands must be `app:pricing:import`, `app:usage:import`, `app:billing:rate`, `app:billing:report`.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Defined `DecimalMoney` class with exact BCMath arithmetic and custom rounding logic.
- [x] Defined `RateSpec` and `RatePlan` enums/classes for pricing types.
- [x] Defined `OffPeakWindow` logic to handle midnight-crossing windows.
- [x] Created `BillingEngine` to orchestrate cost calculation using `PriceBook`.
- [x] Created `PriceBook` to resolve the correct `RatePlan` for a given provider/model/timestamp.
- [x] Implemented `UsageEvent` and `RateResult` domain models.
- [x] Created Doctrine entities for `Provider`, `Model`, `Rate`, `UsageEvent`.
- [x] Implemented `ApplicationServices` orchestrator.
- [x] Created CLI commands (`ImportPrices`, `ImportUsage`, `RateBilling`, `ReportBilling`).
- [x] **Fixed `RateSpec` class definition** (it was missing from the codebase, causing `PriceRow` and `BillingEngine` to fail).
- [x] **Fixed `ProviderRef` class definition** (created `src/Domain/Pricing/ProviderRef.php` as it was missing).
- [x] **Fixed `BillingEngine`**: Changed `$offPeak->contains()` to `$offPeak->inWindow()`.
- [x] **Identified DecimalMoney bug**: Subtraction returning incorrect trailing dot (e.g., `3.25.` instead of `3.25`).
- [x] **Identified DecimalMoney bug**: `fromDecimalString` rejects leading zeros like `007`.

### In Progress
- [ ] **Fix `DecimalMoney::sum()` and `::canonical()`**:
    - The `sum` function produces strings like `3.25.` for `5 - 1.75`.
    - `fromDecimalString` regex `'/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d+)?$/'` rejects `007` and likely causes the trailing dot issue if the input isn't strictly canonicalized before BCMath ops or if the output of BCMath isn't strictly trimmed.
    - *Current Status*: `DecimalMoney` needs a robust `normalize`/`canonical` method that strips leading zeros (allowing `-0`) and trailing zeros/dots.

### Blocked
- **DecimalMoney arithmetic verification**: Tests are failing for subtraction (`5-1.75` => `3.25.` instead of `3.25`). This needs to be resolved before billing calculations can be trusted.

## Key Decisions
- **DecimalMoney**: Custom implementation using BCMath wrapper to ensure `HALF_UP` rounding and exact arithmetic, avoiding native `round()` float issues.
- **Off-Peak Logic**: Window is `[startMinutes, endMinutes)`. If `start > end`, it crosses midnight (e.g., 20:00-02:00 is `1200` to `120`).
- **Price Resolution**: `PriceBook` selects the most recent `validFrom <= eventTs`.

## Next Steps
1. **Fix `src/Domain/Money/DecimalMoney.php`**:
   - Update `canonical()` or the output of `sum()`, `negate()`, etc., to ensure the string is always in strict decimal format (e.g., `3.25`, not `3.25.` or `03.25`).
   - Ensure `fromDecimalString` accepts valid inputs but `toBcString` always outputs clean canonical form.
2. **Re-run DecimalMoney tests**:
   ```bash
   php /tmp/test_money.php
   ```
   Verify `5-1.75` => `3.25`, `1.75-5` => `-3.25`, `007` => `7`.
3. **Verify BillingEngine**:
   - Ensure `BillingEngine` correctly uses `PriceBook` and `OffPeakWindow`.
   - Test full end-to-end with `fixtures/prices.json` and `fixtures/usage.jsonl`.
4. **CLI Integration**:
   - Ensure `ApplicationServices` correctly passes data between import and rating.

## Critical Context
- **File Structure**:
  - `src/Domain/Money/DecimalMoney.php`: Core arithmetic.
  - `src/Domain/Billing/BillingEngine.php`: Orchestrates rating.
  - `src/Domain/Pricing/PriceBook.php`: Resolves active rate.
  - `src/Domain/Pricing/OffPeakWindow.php`: Checks time windows.
  - `src/Infrastructure/Doctrine/`: Mapped entities.
  - `src/Application/`: Service layer.
  - `src/Command/`: CLI entry points.
- **Known Bug**: `DecimalMoney` subtraction returns `3.25.` (trailing dot). This is likely due to BCMath output or a custom `sum` implementation that doesn't trim. `fromDecimalString` also rejects `007`.
- **Fix Applied**: `RateSpec.php` and `ProviderRef.php` were created to resolve missing class errors. `BillingEngine` now calls `inWindow` instead of `contains`.

Now I can see the remaining bugs in `sum()`. Let me trace through `5 - 1.75`:

- `sum("5", "-1.75")` → signA='', signB='-'
- signA ≠ signB → different signs
- `cmp('5','', '1','75')` → a="500", b="175" → a > b (c=1)
- `subMag('5','', '1','75')`:
  - len=2, fBig="00", fSml="75"
  - borrow: true (fBig < fSml)
  - **BUG: bcsub('1'.'00','75', strlen('100')=3)** → bcsub is computing a float with scale 3, which gives "0.25" as a 3-decimal number? No wait, bcsub('100','75',3) = '25' (integer subtraction with scale 3 for the decimal point). Actually BC math: `bcsub('100','75',3)` is the same as `100 - 75 = 25` — scale just controls decimal places. So it returns "25" (or "025"?).

Let me check: `bcsub('100', '75', 3)` — in BC math, '100' and '75' are integer strings, scale=3 means 3 decimal places in the result. Since both are integers, the result is "25" (or "25.000"?). No — BC math treats all numbers as strings, so '100' - '75' = '25', and scale 3 is only relevant if there's a remainder, since these are integers, it's just '25'.

Actually wait, `bcsub` works on string numbers. `'100' - '75' = '25'`. The `scale` parameter only matters if there's division involved, not with integer subtraction. So it should just be '25'.

Let me actually test this in PHP:

string(2) "25"
string(6) "25.000"

That's the bug! `bcsub('100','75',3)` returns `'25.000'` (a decimal string), not `'25'`. And my test shows `'25.000'`. So the fractional result has a decimal point in it, which breaks the `canonical()` logic.

The fix: use scale=0 for integer subtractions of padded fraction digits:

string(2) "25"
string(1) "5"

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Pricing;

final class OffPeakWindow
{
    /**
     * Window on UTC time-of-day: [startMinutes, endMinutes), may cross midnight.
     * Multiplier applies to the whole event cost when the event falls in the window.
     */
    public function __construct(
        public readonly int $startMinutes,
        public readonly int $endMinutes,
        public readonly string $multiplier, // decimal string
    ) {
        if ($startMinutes < 0 || $startMinutes >= 1440) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Start minutes out of range.');
        }
        if ($endMinutes < 0 || $endMinutes >= 1440) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('End minutes out of range.');
        }
    }

    public function inWindow(int $minutesOfDay): bool
    {
        if ($this->startMinutes <= $this->endMinutes) {
            return $minutesOfDay >= $this->startMinutes && $minutesOfDay < $this->endMinutes;
        }
        // crosses midnight
        return $minutesOfDay >= $this->startMinutes || $minutesOfDay < $this->endMinutes;
    }

    public static function fromHhmm(string $startHhmm, string $endHhmm, string $multiplier): self
    {
        return new self(self::toMinutes($startHhmm), self::toMinutes($endHhmm), $multiplier);
    }

    private static function toMinutes(string $hhmm): int
    {
        if (preg_match('/^(\d{2}):(\d{2})$/', $hhmm, $m) !== 1) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Invalid HH:MM: "%s"', $hhmm));
        }
        $h = (int) $m[1];
        $mm = (int) $m[2];
        if ($h >= 24 || $mm >= 60) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Invalid HH:MM: "%s"', $hhmm));
        }

        return $h * 60 + $mm;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Pricing;

/**
 * Immutable snapshot of the price book: providers, models, all price rows.
 *
 * Row selection by (provider, model, tsUtc) returns the row whose validFrom
 * is the greatest value ≤ tsUtc (most recent in force); null ⇒ no price row
 * in force at that time ⇒ the event is unrated, not an error.
 */
final class PriceBook
{
    /**
     * @param ProviderRef[] $providers        code => ref
     * @param PriceRow[]    $allRows          flat list, any order
     * @param string[]      $knownModelCodes  model codes that exist (may be unknown to the book if the provider is known)
     */
    public function __construct(
        private readonly array $providers,
        /** @var array<array-key, PriceRow> */
        private readonly array $allRows,
        /** @var set<string>|array<string,bool> known "<provider>:<model>" */
        private readonly array $knownModelKeys,
    ) {
    }

    public static function fromRows(array $providers, array $allRows, array $knownModelKeys): self
    {
        return new self($providers, $allRows, $knownModelKeys);
    }

    public function knownModels(): array
    {
        return array_keys($this->knownModelKeys);
    }

    public function hasModel(string $providerCode, string $modelCode): bool
    {
        return isset($this->knownModelKeys[$providerCode.':'.$modelCode]);
    }

    public function providerOffPeak(string $providerCode): ?OffPeakWindow
    {
        $ref = isset($this->providers[$providerCode]) ? $this->providers[$providerCode] : null;

        return $ref instanceof ProviderRef ? $ref->offPeak : null;
    }

    public function allRows(): array
    {
        return array_values($this->allRows);
    }

    /**
     * Most recent price row (validFrom ≤ tsUtc) for the given model.
     */
    public function rateInForce(string $providerCode, string $modelCode, \DateTimeImmutable $tsUtc): ?PriceRow
    {
        $chosen = null;
        foreach ($this->allRows as $row) {
            if ($row->providerCode !== $providerCode || $row->modelCode !== $modelCode) {
                continue;
            }
            if ($row->validFrom <= $tsUtc && ($chosen === null || $row->validFrom >= $chosen->validFrom)) {
                $chosen = $row;
            }
        }

        return $chosen;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Domain\Pricing;

/**
 * Immutable rate specification: either a unified "any" rate or
 * per-direction rates (input, output, cache_read, cache_write).
 */
final class RateSpec
{
    public function __construct(
        public readonly string $unit,          // 'per_1m_tokens' | 'per_1m_tokens_unified'
        public readonly string $currency,
        /** @var array<string,string> decimal-string rates, e.g. ['input' => '3.0', 'output' => '12.0'] */
        private readonly array $rates,
    ) {
        if ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified') {
            if (!array_key_exists('any', $rates)) {
                throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Unified rate must define "any".');
            }
        } elseif ($unit === 'per_1m_tokens') {
            foreach (['input', 'output', 'cache_read', 'cache_write'] as $k) {
                if (!array_key_exists($k, $rates)) {
                    throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Split rate must define \"$k\".");
                }
            }
        } else {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("Unknown rate unit: $unit");
        }
    }

    public function rate(string $kind): string
    {
        if (!array_key_exists($kind, $this->rates)) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException("No rate for \"$kind\" (have: " . implode(', ', array_keys($this->rates)) . ')');
        }
        return $this->rates[$kind];
    }

    public function isUnified(): bool
    {
        return $this->unit === 'per_1m_tokens_unified';
    }

    /** @return array<string,string> */
    public function rates(): array
    {
        return $this->rates;
    }
}

# Тестовое задание: учёт расходов на LLM-токены

Задание проверяет умение проектировать доменную логику и писать рабочий код
бэкенда. Мы ожидаем осмысленное предметное моделирование (DDD приветствуется),
аккуратную работу с деньгами и временем, и код, функциональный на базовом
уровне. Ориентир по времени — 4–6 часов; лучше меньше, но работающее, чем
больше и неработающее.

Всё выполняется в этом репозитории. Как поднять окружение — `README.md`
в корне; зависимости уже в `vendor/`.

## Контекст

Сервис перепродаёт доступ к LLM: он платит провайдерам за токены и должен
знать свои расходы в разрезе пользователей и моделей. Данные приходят двумя
потоками:

- **история цен** — справочник: провайдеры, их модели и цены, действовавшие
  с определённых моментов времени;
- **события использования** — журнал фактических запросов к моделям
  (сколько каких токенов израсходовано), поставляемый провайдерами.

Нужно консольное приложение, которое принимает эти данные и считает расходы.
Реальность вносит тонкости — все они зафиксированы в требованиях ниже:

- у провайдеров **разные схемы тарификации** (per-token с разбивкой по видам
  токенов у одного, единая цена за любой токен у другого);
- **цены меняются во времени**: событие тарифицируется ценой, действовавшей
  в его момент, а не текущей;
- у одного провайдера есть **оф-пиковая скидка** в фиксированном окне UTC;
- провайдеры **присылают дубли** событий — двойного списания быть не должно;
- деньги считаются только **точной десятичной арифметикой** (float для
  денег запрещён).

## Входные данные

### История цен — JSON-файл

Пример (сокращённый; полный рабочий пример — `fixtures/prices.json`):

```json
{
  "providers": [
    {
      "code": "prism",
      "name": "Prism AI",
      "off_peak": {
        "window_start": "16:30",
        "window_end": "00:30",
        "multiplier": "0.5"
      }
    },
    { "code": "sfera", "name": "Sfera Cloud", "off_peak": null }
  ],
  "models": [
    { "provider": "prism", "code": "lumen-8" },
    { "provider": "sfera", "code": "gyro-pro" }
  ],
  "prices": [
    {
      "provider": "prism",
      "model": "lumen-8",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens",
      "rates": {
        "input": "3.000000",
        "output": "12.000000",
        "cache_read": "0.300000",
        "cache_write": "3.750000"
      }
    },
    {
      "provider": "sfera",
      "model": "gyro-pro",
      "valid_from": "2026-08-01T00:00:00Z",
      "currency": "USD",
      "unit": "per_1m_tokens_unified",
      "rates": { "any": "2.400000" }
    }
  ]
}
```

Пояснения:

- `unit` задаёт схему тарификации:
  - `per_1m_tokens` — цена за 1 000 000 токенов отдельно для каждого вида:
    `input`, `output`, `cache_read`, `cache_write`;
  - `per_1m_tokens_unified` — единая цена за 1 000 000 токенов любого вида.
- `off_peak` — окно скидки провайдера по времени суток UTC:
  `window_start` включительно, `window_end` исключительно; окно может
  переходить через полночь (`16:30`–`00:30`); `multiplier` — множитель
  стоимости события, попавшего в окно. `null` — скидки нет.
- у одной модели может быть несколько строк цен с разными `valid_from`;
- `rates` — десятичные строки (не числа JSON), 6 знаков после точки;
- `currency` везде `USD` (поле зарезервировано на будущее).

### События использования — JSONL-файл

Одно событие на строку:

```json
{"provider": "prism", "provider_request_id": "e1", "model": "lumen-8", "user": "u-alice", "ts": "2026-09-15T11:00:00Z", "tokens_input": 1200000, "tokens_output": 800000, "tokens_cache_read": 2500000, "tokens_cache_write": 83333}
```

- `ts` — момент запроса, ISO-8601, всегда UTC (`Z`);
- `user` — идентификатор пользователя (строка), домена пользователей нет;
- `provider_request_id` — идентификатор запроса **со стороны провайдера**;
  вместе с `provider` образует естественный ключ события;
- количество токенов — целые ≥ 0, любые могут быть нулевыми (в т.ч. все).

## Правила тарификации

1. **Выбор цены.** Событие тарифицируется строкой цен своей модели с
   наибольшим `valid_from` ≤ `ts` события (`valid_from` включительно).
   Если такой строки нет — событие **unrated** (см. п. 7).
2. **Схема `per_1m_tokens`** — сумма по видам токенов:
   `cost = Σ tokens_вид × rate_вид / 1 000 000`.
   **Схема `per_1m_tokens_unified`**:
   `cost = (tokens_input + tokens_output + tokens_cache_read + tokens_cache_write) × rate_any / 1 000 000`.
3. **Оф-пик.** Если время суток `ts` (UTC) попадает в окно `[window_start, window_end)`
   провайдера события — стоимость всего события умножается на `multiplier`.
   Окно задаётся на уровне провайдера и действует для всех его моделей;
   отсутствие `off_peak` означает отсутствие скидки.
4. **Точность вычислений.** Все промежуточные вычисления — без округления
   (десятичная арифметика с запасом точности, например bcmath с масштабом
   ≥ 16). Округление ровно одно: итоговая стоимость **события** округляется
   до 6 знаков после точки по правилу HALF_UP (2.5 → 3). Суммы отчёта —
   сумма уже округлённых стоимостей событий, без повторного округления
   слагаемых. Тип float для денег использовать запрещено.
5. **Идемпотентность приёма.** События дедуплицируются по ключу
   `(provider, provider_request_id)`: повторная доставка уже известного
   события целиком игнорируется (никаких обновлений, никаких доначислений).
   Одинаковые `provider_request_id` у разных провайдеров — это разные
   события.
6. **Период отчёта.** `--from` включительно, `--to` исключительно.
7. **Unrated-события.** Не считаются ошибкой: не тарифицируются, в отчёт
   не попадают. Каждый запуск тарификации повторяет попытку для всех
   ещё не рассчитанных событий (цены могли подтянуться позже).

## Команды

Все команды — через `bin/console`. Вывод отчёта — строго в stdout,
служебные сообщения — в stderr.

### `app:prices:import <file>`

Загружает провайдеров, модели и строки цен. Идемпотентный upsert:
провайдеры — по `code`; модели — по `(provider, code)`; строки цен — по
`(provider, model, valid_from)` (повторная загрузка тех же сумм — не
изменяет данных). Код выхода 0. Некорректный JSON — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:usage:import <file>`

Загружает события по правилу п. 5. Код выхода 0 даже если все строки —
дубли. Некорректная строка JSONL — ошибка, код 1.

### `app:billing:rate`

Тарифицирует все ещё не рассчитанные события (включая повторные попытки
unrated). В stdout — сводка одной строкой: `RATED=<n> UNRATED=<m>`, где
n и m — количества событий, рассчитанных и оставшихся unrated **в этом
запуске**. Для каждого unrated-события этого запуска — строка в stderr:
`UNRATED <provider>/<provider_request_id> <ts> no_price`. Код выхода 0.

### `app:billing:report [--from=<iso>] [--to=<iso>]`

CSV в stdout (кодировка UTF-8, разделитель `,`, перевод строки `\n`):

```
user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd
u-alice,prism/lumen-8,1200000,800000,2500000,83333,14.262499
u-alice,sfera/gyro-pro,3000000,500000,0,0,8.400000
u-bob,prism/lumen-8,2000000,1000000,0,0,11.000000
TOTAL,,6200000,2300000,2500000,83333,33.662499
```

Требования к формату:

- первая строка — заголовок, точно как в примере;
- строки данных — по одной на пару (user, model), отсортированные по
  `user`, затем по `model` (лексикографически, по возрастанию);
- `model` — `<provider>/<code>` (например `prism/lumen-8`);
- количества токенов — суммы по событиям группы, целые без разделителей;
- `cost_usd` — сумма стоимостей событий группы, ровно 6 знаков после
  точки;
- последняя строка — `TOTAL` с пустым полем `model` и суммами по отчёту;
- unrated-события в отчёт не попадают никогда.

`--from`/`--to` — ISO-8601 (UTC), применяются к `ts` событий по п. 6;
без опций отчёт покрывает все события.

## Бонус (по желанию, оценивается отдельно)

**Ретро-коррекция цены.** Провайдер сообщил, что цена, действовавшая с
некоторого `valid_from`, была неверной, и присылает исправленную строку
(файл того же формата). Уже рассчитанные события трогать молча нельзя —
расходы показаны пользователю. Реализуйте команду:

```
bin/console app:billing:reprice <file>
```

Она применяет исправленные строки (upsert по `(provider, model, valid_from)`
по данным уже загруженного справочника — провайдер и модель должны существовать
в базе, а не в самом файле коррекции: секции `providers`/`models` в нём могут
отсутствовать или быть пустыми), пересчитывает события, тарифицировавшиеся
заменёнными строками, и печатает в stdout ровно две строки:

```
REPRICED_EVENTS=<n>
REPRICE_DELTA_USD=<x.xxxxxx>
```

`n` — число пересчитанных событий, дельта — новая минус старая сумма их
стоимостей, 6 знаков. Механизм пересчёта (перезапись с журналом
корректировок, компенсирующие записи и т.п.) — на ваше усмотрение; итоговый
`app:billing:report` после reprice должен показывать пересчитанные суммы
без задвоений.

 *  - add()/subtract()/multiply()/multiplyByInteger()/divideByInteger() are

 *    integers);
 *  - the single allowed rounding step is roundTo(): HALF_UP (2.5 → 3) to
 *    ROUND_SCALE = 6 digits, applied once to the exact per-event cost.

final class DecimalMoney
{
    /** The one allowed rounding scale of the domain. */
    public const ROUND_SCALE = 6;

    /** Working scale for intermediates — ample headroom. */
    private const WORK_SCALE = 24;

    /** @var string canonical decimal value ("0", "14.26249875", "-3" ...) */
    private readonly string $value;

    private function __construct(string $value)
    {
        $this->value = self::canonical($value);
    }

    public static function fromDecimalString(string $value): self
    {
        $value = trim($value);
        if (preg_match('/^-?(0|[1-9]\d*)(\.\d+)?$/', $value) !== 1) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException(sprintf('Invalid decimal value: "%s"', $value));
        }

        return new self($value);
    }

    public static function zero(): self
    {
        return new self('0');
    }

    public function isZero(): bool
    {
        return self::valueIsZero($this->value);
    }

    public function isNegative(): bool
    {
        return str_starts_with($this->value, '-') && !self::valueIsZero($this->value);
    }

    public function add(self $other): self
    {
        return new self(self::sum($this->value, $other->value));
    }

    public function subtract(self $other): self
    {
        return new self(self::sum($this->value, self::negate($other->value)));
    }

    /** Exact product. */
    public function multiply(self $other): self
    {
        return new self(self::mul($this->value, $other->value));
    }

    /** Exact: multiplying a decimal by an integer adds no fractional digits. */
    public function multiplyByInteger(int $factor): self
    {
        return new self(self::mul($this->value, (string) $factor));
    }

    /** Exact division by a non-zero integer (domain: "tokens·rate" ÷ 1 000 000). */
    public function divideByInteger(int $divisor): self
    {
        if ($divisor === 0) {
            throw new \DivisionByZeroError('Division by zero.');
        }

        return new self(self::divInt($this->value, $divisor));

     * the rounding decision.

    {
        if ($scale < 0 || $scale > self::ROUND_SCALE) {
            throw new \InvalidArgumentException('Scale out of range.');

        $mag = ltrim($this->value, '-');

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Command;

use App\Application\ApplicationServices;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Attribute\AsCommand;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Command\Command;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputArgument;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Input\InputInterface;
use Symfony\Component\Console\Output\OutputInterface;

#[AsCommand(name: 'app:prices:import', description: 'Import provider/model/price book from a JSON file.')]
final class PricesImportCommand extends Command
{
    protected static string $defaultName = 'app:prices:import';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ApplicationServices $app,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this->addArgument('file', InputArgument::REQUIRED, 'Path to the prices JSON file');
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $path = (string) $input->getArgument('file');
        $stderr = $output->getErrorOutput();

        if (!is_file($path) || !is_readable($path)) {
            $stderr->writeln(sprintf('ERROR: not found or not readable: %s', $path));
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $raw = file_get_contents($path);
        if ($raw === false) {
            $stderr->writeln('ERROR: could not read file');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        $payload = json_decode($raw, true);
        if (!is_array($payload)) {
            $stderr->writeln('ERROR: not a valid JSON object');
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        try {
            $result = $this->app->importPrices($payload);
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            $stderr->writeln('ERROR: ' . $e->getMessage());
            return Command::FAILURE;
        }

        // print per-entry errors to stderr
        foreach ($result->errors as $err) {
            $stderr->writeln($err);
        }

        $output->writeln(sprintf('IMPORTED_PROVIDERS=%d IMPORTED_MODELS=%d IMPORTED_PRICES=%d',
            $result->providers, $result->models, $result->prices));

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }
}

use DateTimeZone;

#[AsCommand(name: 'app:billing:report', description: 'Print a CSV report of rated usage events.')]
final class BillingReportCommand extends Command
{
    protected static string $defaultName = 'app:billing:report';

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ApplicationServices $app,
    ) {
        parent::__construct();
    }

    protected function configure(): void
    {
        $this
            ->addOption('from', null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'Start datetime, ISO-8601 UTC, inclusive')
            ->addOption('to',   null, InputOption::VALUE_REQUIRED, 'End datetime, ISO-8601 UTC, exclusive');
    }

    protected function execute(InputInterface $input, OutputInterface $output): int
    {
        $stderr = $output->getErrorOutput();
        $utc = new DateTimeZone('UTC');

        $from = $this->parseDate($input->getOption('from'), 'from', $stderr);
        if ($from === null) return Command::FAILURE;
        $to = $this->parseDate($input->getOption('to'), 'to', $stderr);
        if ($to === null) return Command::FAILURE;

        $report = $this->app->reportRange($from, $to);

        // Build CSV — write to STDOUT (not getErrorOutput)
        $io = $output; // OutputInterface
        $stream = $io instanceof OutputInterface ? $io : null;

        // Symfony Console: use writeln with StreamOutput or plain echo
        // For strict stdout, we collect lines and print them in one block
        $lines = [];
        $lines[] = 'user,model,tokens_input,tokens_output,tokens_cache_read,tokens_cache_write,cost_usd';

        foreach ($report['groups'] as $g) {
            $lines[] = implode(',', [
                $g['user'],
                $g['model'],
                (string) $g['input'],
                (string) $g['output'],
                (string) $g['cache_read'],
                (string) $g['cache_write'],
                $g['cost']->format(6),
            ]);
        }

        $t = $report['totals'];
        $lines[] = implode(',', [
            'TOTAL', '',
            (string) $t['input'],
            (string) $t['output'],
            (string) $t['cache_read'],
            (string) $t['cache_write'],
            $t['cost']->format(6),
        ]);

        // Print to stdout directly (avoid stderr)
        fwrite(STDOUT, implode("\n", $lines) . "\n");

        return Command::SUCCESS;
    }

    private function parseDate(?string $raw, string $label, OutputInterface $stderr): ?DateTimeImmutable
    {
        if ($raw === null || $raw === '') return null;
        try {
            $dt = new DateTimeImmutable($raw, new DateTimeZone('UTC'));
            return $dt->setTimezone(new DateTimeZone('UTC'));
        } catch (\Exception) {
            $stderr->writeln("ERROR: --$label: invalid ISO-8601 datetime: $raw");
            return null;
        }
    }
}
